jobs.title: Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II - IHSS (Open)
jobs.description:
San Mateo County Health is seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to serve as the **Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II – In-Home Supportive Services Public Authority (ESPI CPS II)** within Aging and Disability Services (ADS).

This position supports the ongoing improvement and modernization of the In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) Public Authority (PA) by developing automated systems, dashboards, and digital tools that enhance program operations, service accessibility, and staff productivity. The role also assists with caregiver recruitment and onboarding, referral coordination, and the development of policies, procedures, and training materials, while ensuring that all initiatives incorporate racial equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.

**Important Note:** The IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist **is not a County classified position;** however, the role reports directly within ADS. The eligible list generated from this recruitment may be used to fill future extra-help, term, unclassified and regular classified vacancies.

This is a full-time position working Monday–Friday. A hybrid schedule may be available; however, approximately four on-site workdays per week are anticipated based on operational needs and County requirements. The position is currently located in San Mateo, CA, but will relocate to South San Francisco, CA, planned for March 2027. The role requires travel throughout the County and periodic travel within the State of California.

**About the IHSS Public Authority**

Established by the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors in 1993, the IHSS Public Authority administers the care provider components of the County’s IHSS program.

IHSS supports Medi-Cal eligible individuals who are aged, blind or living with disabilities at any age so they can safely remain in their homes as an alternative to institutional care.

**The IHSS Public Authority:**

* Serves as the employer of record for approximately 10,000 IHSS care providers
* Operates a Registry that recruits, screens, and refers care providers to IHSS recipients
* Conducts background checks in accordance with IHSS regulations
* Provides training opportunities to enhance care provider skills
* Offers support to both recipients and care providers to promote successful working relationships
* Administers payroll, personnel services, health benefits, and COBRA
* Maintains employment records, conducts verifications, and responds to subpoenas
* The IHSS PA is advised by the Public Authority Advisory Committee (PAAC), appointed by the Board of Supervisors, with a majority of the members being current or former IHSS recipients and/or care providers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**The** **IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist** **will:**

* Assist in development and maintenance of systems, automated tools, and improvement charters designed to boost IHSS PA operations utilizing both AAS’ Racial Equity Action Plan (REAP) and LEAP process improvement standards
* Implement Quality Assurance (QA) standards in the development and maintenance of dashboards and reporting systems that will be used in IHSS PA work processes, as well as monitor staff workload and productivity
* Assist in the development and maintenance of a self-service portal for referral submissions by external entities
* Assist in the development and maintenance of an online job board intended to help match IHSS recipients with care providers, implementing equity, diversity, and inclusion standards.
* Assist in the migration of paper-driven onboarding processes to digital processes, a process that will expedite accessibility of newly hired care providers to IHSS recipients
* Assist in recruiting and onboarding care providers, to help remediate the current care provider shortage, utilizing a racial equity lens
* Work with the IHSS PA Supervisors to devise, triage, and assign referrals to Payroll Specialists and Registry Social Workers
* Work closely with IHSS Community Program Analysts in the development and maintenance of automation-related projects designed to enhance the accessibility of Payroll and Registry services for IHSS recipients
* Update existing and create new IHSS PA policies and procedures to reflect current and new programmatic practices
* Update existing training materials and training IHSS PA staff, integrating a social and equity lens

The **ideal candidate** will be:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, well suited for large government or non-profit social service programs.
* Experience working with case management databases like the Case Management, Information and Payrolling Services (CMIPS II) and Microsoft Suite Applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Excel).
* Experience with process improvement best practices and LEAP process improvement principles and methodologies.
* Experience training community members and/or staff in programmatic updates and new operational requirements requiring updated work practices.
* Strong understanding of social and racial equity principles leading to the County of San Mateo’s Equity Framework.

**Qualifications**
------------------

***Knowledge of:***

* Principles, practices, and administrative requirements of the program to which assigned.
* Contemporary social, political and economic trends and problems related to community services.
* Principles of social planning and program development related to community services.
* Specialized technical knowledge related to assigned program area.
* Monitoring and evaluating systems for community services programs.
* Current social and community needs.
* Principles and practices in community development and services planning.
* Methods applied to the collection and evaluation of statistical data.
* Principles of community organization.
* Applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations and County and program policies and guidelines.
* Computer applications related to the work.
* Office

At Claremont Resort & Club, we believe that exceptional hospitality starts with extraordinary people. For over a century, our iconic resort has set the standard for luxury and service in the Bay Area. We take pride in creating memorable experiences for our guests—and a rewarding, inclusive workplace for our colleagues. Situated on 22 acres in the Berkeley and Oakland Hills, Claremont Resort & Club seamlessly blends its rich 19th-century history with the modern day to offer the very best of the Bay Area. Guests dine with friends at Limewood, relax at our urban oasis, The Spa at the Claremont, and discover total wellness at The Club at the Claremont- all while taking in the breathtaking views of the San Francisco Bay.

The Member Services Representative I/Floater will assist and provide coverage for all of the Meriwest Credit Union Financial Centers as needed. The Floater schedule can vary frequently, and this position requires adaptability based on the needs of the branches. Processes financial transactions efficiently, accurately, and with the highest level of customer service. Incorporates Service Plus into all aspects of member contacts and continually builds relationships with members in order to retain and increase memberships. Further enhances these relationships through the cross-selling of credit union products and services to meet all the members’ financial needs. jobs.title: Manager, New Verticals - Pharmacy Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The New Verticals team is building the future of local commerce through expanding our product offerings on our marketplace platform. We launched in 2020 and have since then built world-class operations to delight our customers with access to Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Pharmacy and Retail delivery through our marketplace. We focus on building new businesses and scale them - this team is focused on building our Pharmacy business from the ground up.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Manager on the Pharmacy Strategy & Operations team, you will own the growth and merchant engine for DoorDash's Pharma business. You will build and execute the go-to-market plan that brings pharmacy merchants onto DoorDash, grows their volume, and keeps them. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and New Verticals platform teams to be successful.

You'll be responsible for turning the pharmacy opportunity into a repeatable motion: planning and launching GTM programs, pitching and negotiating with merchants, and shaping how we speak to returning customers about pharmacy on DoorDash. You are the owner for knowing how Pharma merchants are performing, where the funnel leaks, and where to place the next bet to drive growth. You turn targets into operating plans, and plans into measurable outcomes.

This role requires strong commercial instincts and comfort with data. You should move fluently between merchant-level detail and business-level economics, build frameworks for tradeoffs and prioritization, and familiarity with modeling different scenarios and outcomes. Experience using SQL and data visualization tools is a plus.

You will report into the GM of Pharmacy S&O and be an individual contributor, with the opportunity to build a team in the future.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Strategize.** From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
* **Operate.** Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
* **Analyze.** Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
* **Experiment.** You'll transform strategies into operational experiments, product features and net-new tooling that create measurable outcomes.
* **Build with AI.** You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
* **Lead, collaborate and Influence.** You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* **You have 6-8+ years of experience.** You've succeeded in similar cultures that are highly analytical and cross-functional (whether in tech, e-commerce, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience). Merchant-facing or healthcare/pharmacy experience is a plus.
* **You are an owner.** You're always looking for opportunities to better your work product and own the outcome – both the good and the bad.
* **You're entrepreneurial.** You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
* **You're analytical.** You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling your own data in SQL, building models, and building the tools you need to create 10x outcomes.
* **You are AI Native.** You root cause problems with a systems first approach and can identify how to automate repeatable tasks using AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini or Copilot.
* **You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot.** You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team.
* **You're a persuasive communicator.** You can pitch and negotiate with senior merchant stakeholders and align internal partners around a plan.
* **You're unafraid of ambiguity.** Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in an ambiguous, startup environment.
* **You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.** MBA is a plus!

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. The Workplace Operations team strives to create world class office spaces, environments and experiences for our employees, including creating environments that support collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a sense of connection to Plaid’s culture.

In this role you'll keep Plaid's San Francisco and Seattle offices running day to day, so the space works for the people who use it, whether they're in every day or a few days a month. That means owning the practical details: how the office is laid out and maintained, how vendors and building management are managed, how programs operate, visitors are greeted, and how health, safety and emergency readiness are planned and rehearsed. You'll also manage the office budget and the contracts behind it, and report on what the space costs and how it's used, so decisions rest on data rather than guesses.

You'll partner with the Security, IT, Legal and People teams to keep the offices in line with company policy and local regulations. You'll manage and develop a team of 3 people across SF and SEA and support their growth.

jobs.title: Quality Manager - Cargo Operation
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

The Quality Manager plays a critical role in driving operational excellence by capturing, validating, and analyzing key performance data to ensure real-time visibility and alignment across the operation. This role is designed to bridge the gap between strategic leadership objectives and day-to-day execution by transforming how KPIs are tracked and utilized. Operating in a data dependent environment, this individual will serve as the operational anchor for performance monitoring and improvement.

**Why This Role Matters:**

This position directly addresses a critical gap in our operation. By ensuring real time KPI visibility and reinforcing data accountability at all levels, the Quality Manager enables faster decision making, operational alignment, and strategic clarity. This role also ensures long-term resilience by serving as a backup to the current reporting function and helping to build a culture of data driven performance.

Alliance Ground International (AGI) is one of the largest independently owned ground handling companies providing services to 100+ airlines in 61 airports across the U.S. and Canada. We are the home to over 12,000 team members supporting over 1.5B Kilos and over 400K departures. We are committed to providing the highest quality service and continuing our outstanding safety track record. As we continue to grow, we only look for the best in the industry.  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **KPI Validation & Monitoring:** Proactively track and validate daily operational KPIs to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and visibility across all departments.
* **Performance Analysis & Reporting:** Develop daily, weekly, and monthly reports with actionable insights to help guide operations leadership and frontline supervisors in decision making.
* **Operational Trend Analysis:** Identify patterns and anomalies in real-time to drive continuous improvement and eliminate reactive management approaches.
* Process Oversight Across Key Areas:
  + Line Haul Departures – Monitor on-time performance, flag delays, and differentiate controllable vs. uncontrollable delays.
  + Flight Departure Optimization – Analyze delay codes to identify and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  + Scan Compliance – Validate container scan compliance from origin to destination to reduce exceptions.
  + Ramp Operations – Track aircraft performance issues tied to labor and procedural deficiencies.
  + Build Plan Execution – Ensure compliance with LDM timing and container planning accuracy.
  + Rolled Freight Analysis – Distinguish between A2G and G2A issues to better isolate root causes.
* **Risk Mitigation & Continuity:** Act as a critical backup to the existing Data & Reporting Lead, preserving institutional knowledge and minimizing operational risk tied to single person dependency.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Serve as a centralized resource for operational teams, supervisors, and leadership to ensure transparency, consistency, and engagement with the KPI process.

**Safety, Security and Compliance**:

All AGI Team members have a responsibility and duty while at work to:

* Take reasonable care for the health, wellbeing, safety, and security of themselves and of others who may be affected by their actions or omissions while at work.
* Cooperate with their manager / supervisor to allow them to perform or comply with any legal requirements imposed on the company.
* Not intentionally or recklessly interfere with or misuse anything provided by the company in the interests of health, wellbeing, safety, security, or welfare reasons.
* Inform their manager / supervisor of any work situation, equipment, or activity that represents a serious or immediate danger to health, wellbeing, safety, and security.
* Report any hazards, near misses, incidents, accidents, or dangerous occurrences to their manager / supervisor, who will then follow the procedures contained in company and carrier Safety and Security procedures.
* Conduct work in accordance with information and training provided and any specific health, wellbeing, safety, and security rules or procedures.
* Fully understand AGI Health & Safety and Security policies.
* Attend training courses as may be required by AGI.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally.
* Must be able to sit for long periods.
* Must be able to use close vision.
* Must have manual dexterity for typing.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* **Education:**
  + Bachelor’s degree in business, Operations, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience in operation).
* **Experience:**
  + 3+ years of experience in operations, quality control, or data analysis, preferably in logistics or cargo handling.
* **Skills:**
  + Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
  + Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  + High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial tools.
  + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  + Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  + Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting tools; familiarity with cargo/logistics data systems is a plus.
  + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  + Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate data into operational strategy.
  + Proven ability to work cross-functionally and lead process improvements in a fast-paced environment.

AGI offers a comprehensive benefit package for all employees, including paid vacation and medical / dental / vision for full-time qualified employees as well as medical coverage for part time employees. jobs.title: Domestic Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction:

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction.

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT. Find out what **our people deliver.®** means when you come move the world with us!

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview:

We are seeking a driven, and highly motivated ***Operations Manager*** to manage our Domestic operations for our station of AIT Worldwide Logistics!

The ***Operations Manager*** is responsible for establishing and executing company strategy related to domestic freight movements through an understanding of industry trends and best practices. Recruit, develop and motivate staff to provide a world class customer experience and meet or exceed client expectations. Ensure the station has the necessary tools in place to succeed and expand their business levels in international products lines in a sustained fashion. Work with current and prospective logistics services providers and internal AIT functions to develop the best overall strategy. Execution of those strategies includes establishing, measuring, and managing applicable metrics with service providers, vendors and internal AIT functions to ensure timely and efficient flow of product for AIT.

Responsibilities:

* Develop and execute the station operations strategy of AIT.
* Ensure processes and metrics are in place to ensure growth, service and profitability goals are accomplished.
* Manage and communicate with AIT’s carriers ensuring best value and service vs objectives
* Ensures providers meet and adhere to the scope of SLA (Service Logistics Agreement) and agreed terms of service.
* Exhibits strong negotiating skills and execution in Freight Forwarding Carrier Agreements.
* Ability to track performance and develop strategic processes and proactively improve efficiencies and reduce lead time lanes.
* Provides coaching and mentoring employees in a broad global environment.
* Actively support key account operations requirements and ensure service execution and reliability.
* Continue to build rapport with clients and work to develop new opportunities and create and manage key visual tools and tracking processes.
* Other duties and responsibilities will be assigned as business demands deem necessary.
* The wage range for this position is $75,810.00-$113,710.00 and may vary based on geography as well as relative knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience.

Qualifications:

* A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value
* A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability, and autonomy in your role
* Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently
* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture

**Other Skills We Hope to See:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics preferred.
* 7-10 years of domestic forwarding experience preferred.
* International freight forwarding, airfreight and ocean freight preferred.
* P&L experience strongly preferred.
* 1-3 years of operations supervisory experience and managing a team required.
* Previous experience in a diversified freight forwarding industry, preferred.
* Procurement skills; Operational and P&L management of global products and services in a high-performance organization.
* Excellent organization and time management skills.
* Excellent communication skills both written and oral with the ability to communicate with employees, manager, and upper management levels.

What AIT Can Offer You:

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

About AIT Worldwide:

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services.

jobs.description:
### **Description**

**Job Summary**:

The Finance Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and execution of assigned Finance Operations functions across HNIB. Operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with significant M&A activity, this role takes ownership of core FinOps workstreams, complex operational issues, agency integrations, and process improvements that support the organization’s continued growth.

The position requires hands-on management, strong problem-solving skills, knowledge of the general ledger, and excellent communication skills. The Manager is accountable for the accurate and timely execution of assigned processes, the independent resolution of issues, and close collaboration with Operations and Agency Principals to integrate and streamline newly acquired agencies while maintaining financial integrity.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**  
Leadership and Team Development

* Manage assigned day-to-day Finance Operations activities across Direct Bill, Cash Receipts, Payables, and related banking functions, with accountability for timely and accurate execution.
* Coach and develop FinOps leads and team members, keeping the team engaged and motivated while adjusting responsibilities to foster growth, accountability, and operational knowledge.
* Take ownership of complex operational issues within assigned areas, drive investigations through resolution, and escalate significant risks or decisions as appropriate.
* Foster a collaborative environment with clear accountability and follow-through, balancing consistent procedures with the evolving needs of the business.

Operations, Process & Systems

* Oversee and improve operational workflows, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and audit compliance while adapting to shifting priorities and building scalable processes as the organization grows.
* Coordinate directly with Accounting, IT, Operations, and Finance leadership to execute system and process changes impacting assigned Finance Operations activities.
* Maintain clear, current process documentation for assigned Finance Operations functions and ensure procedures are followed as processes evolve.
* Drive standardization and efficiency across acquired agencies and operational teams, identifying gaps and implementing practical solutions.
* Serve as the primary Finance Operations liaison to Operations for assigned M&A integrations; own the transition of newly acquired agencies into standardized workflows, resolve integration issues, and coordinate with Accounting and agency teams through implementation.
* Own year-end procedures and audit deliverables for Finance Operations, ensuring timely completion and resolution of outstanding issues.

General Ledger & Cash Management

* Apply strong general ledger knowledge to ensure assigned Finance Operations activity is accurately reflected in financial reporting.
* Own the investigation and resolution of discrepancies between operational subledgers and the general ledger, coordinating with Accounting counterparts as needed.
* Resolve accounting and reconciliation issues arising from operational transactions and guide team members on their financial impact.
* Monitor daily cash positions across HNIB and its subsidiaries, identify funding or liquidity needs, and promptly communicate and act on exceptions.
* Coordinate approved movement and sweeping of excess subsidiary cash, ensuring transactions are accurate, timely, and properly recorded.
* Proactively identify, investigate, and communicate operational issues affecting cash timing, reconciliations, or financial reporting; drive corrective action.

Team Player and Role Model:

* Be a role model for the finance team, embodying the organization's values and promoting a culture of excellence, integrity, and accountability.
* Communicate clearly, directly, and proactively with agency leaders, Operations, Accounting, and other cross-functional teams; own follow-through on issues and commitments.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Accounting, or a related business discipline.

Experience

* 5–7 years of experience in finance, accounting, or financial operations, including 1–3 years of supervisory or management experience.
* Strong general ledger knowledge, problem-solving skills, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with M&A integrations, multi-entity operations, or the insurance industry is a plus.

  

### **Why Choose Heffernan?**

  

At Heffernan, our culture is guided by the Heffernan Habits, prioritizing communication, respect, fun, community impact, and celebrating what makes each of us unique. We’re proud of our strong commitment to philanthropy and giving back, and we support our employees with a comprehensive benefits package designed to promote well-being, growth, and long-term success.
  
  
**Heffernan Habits:**

These are core values that represent our unique culture.

* ***Answer The Phone (And Email):*** Communication is the foundation of success in life, work, and relationships. It begins with being present and responsive to both clients and colleagues. Listen to what is said and notice what goes unsaid.
* ***Have Fun:*** Fun is something we don’t shy away from, and participation brings us together on many different levels. Take the time to know your colleagues and let barriers fall away. If we are happy and enjoy time together, we will do a better job for our clients and for one another!
* ***Be Respectful*****:** Lend a hand, be kind, and smooth the path. Respect is the cornerstone of developing and maintaining strong relationships. Lead with humility, take ownership of your actions, and ease the way for others. We are in this together as a team, as a family, and as trusted advisors to many.
* ***Do Good*****:** This is our core. We strive to do good for our clients, our community, and our planet.

jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesSafety & SupportID: 50009

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We're building the future of entertainment, and our Support Operations team plays a crucial role in ensuring a positive experience for our growing community. Support Operations is chartered with enabling Roblox’s customer service operations teams, through change management, subject matter expertise and by transforming the customer experience through strategy and execution. Product Support Managers power that mission, owning the end to end service delivery experience for the product and feature teams they support. We're looking for an experienced Manager to lead a team of Senior Product Support Manager to join our Support Operations team, focused on delivering exceptional agent and user experiences across all channels of support.

You will report to the Director of Support Operations and work across teams at Roblox to make a step-change in the support experience. You will lead a team of subject matter experts focused on specific Roblox’s product strategies, enabling them to create and innovate high-quality support experiences through chatbot and agent support channels. This role is highly cross-functional, bridging the gap between operations and product.

Through data-driven insights, you will drive programs around weekly business reviews, voice of the customer to ensure we are continuously making recommendations for process improvements, product enhancements, agent tooling and automation that enable a more frictionless, consistent customer experience. You will partner with product leaders, influencing their roadmaps by providing insights gained from our global customer interactions. You will also work with Engineering to ensure that identified gaps are addressed and resolved in a timely manner. Lastly, as you create recommendations, you will operationalize these recommendations through strong program management in partnership with Operations, Product, Marketing, Finance, and others.

### **You Will**

* **Lead and develop a team of Product Support Managers.** Mentor, coach, and grow your team. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and user focus.
* **Drive outcomes through metrics.** Own top-line metrics such as Contact Rate, Average Handle Time, Time to Resolution and Recontact Rate. Use data to prioritize investments and hold your team and partners accountable.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Translate customer interaction insights into recommendations that shape the product roadmap, and partner with Engineering to get gaps resolved quickly.
* **Deliver multi-quarter programs.** Scope and run large, cross-functional initiatives in technology, training, knowledge, and workflow solutions with Operations, Product, Marketing, Finance, and others.
* **Partner with our India Operations team**. Building swimlanes of the supporting work needed to enable the success of our Product Support Managers, including Escalations, knowledge base documentation and agent feedback loops.
* **Partner with BPO and workforce teams.** Make sure agent needs are met, quality is consistent, and changes land smoothly across the agent population.
* **Ensure launch readiness.** Own Product Support launch management and go-to-market documentation so CS Operations teams are ready for every release.
* **Build the knowledge foundation.** Set standards for knowledge, macros, and process documentation for internal and external audiences.

### **You Have**

* 6+ years of experience in operations management or product support, with a focus on creator and user experiences
* 2+ years of experience managing and developing people
* Experience developing processes that improve operational efficiency at scale
* Strong data skills, with experience using metrics to lead decision-making
* Strong program management skills and experience leading projects at scale
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams, specifically Product, Engineering, international and BPO workforces
* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience

### **You Are**

* **Versatile:** Comfortable across technologies and approaches, and creative and strategic with hard problems.
* **Analytical:** Energized by large, ambiguous problems, and disciplined about measuring both problems and solutions.
* **User-oriented:** You start with the needs of the user, whether a Roblox player, creator, agent, or internal engineer.
* **Team-oriented:** You lift up your team and peers and leave the organization stronger.

All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**.

* Responsible for assisting pharmacist in the delivery of patient care including patient registration, prescription data entry, preparation of medications for patients, counting, and verifying (where allowed by law). Completes patient and physician calls under the supervision of a pharmacist (where allowed by law). Under the supervision of a pharmacist assists with healthcare service offerings including administering vaccines, health screenings, and any health services allowed by law.
* Within the guidelines of authorized company policies, state and federal laws/regulations, exercises independent judgment to delegate, direct, and assign non-clinical work in the pharmacy. Ensures tasks are completed on-time and holds others accountable for efficient workflow.
* At the direction of the Pharmacy Manager or pharmacist, prepares, and files reports and records required by the company and various government agencies.
* Manages core pharmacy workflow and drives excellence in pharmacy operations. Coordinates and organizes pharmacy daily schedule of activities. Recommends allocation of pharmacy hours. Assures the pharmacy is clean, neat, orderly, and stocked with adequate supplies.
* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in-place.
* Under supervision of the pharmacist, strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription-dispensing activities and understands their role in ensuring that the elements of Good Faith Dispensing are met.
* Maintains and applies knowledge of Company asset protection techniques. Supports Pharmacy Manager with diversion monitoring and reports any concerns that would compromise the security of the pharmacy to the Pharmacy Manager.
* Communicates prescription errors to the accountable pharmacist, and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Continuous Quality Improvement Program.
* Ensures the accurate processing of insurance claims to resolve customer issues and prevent payment rejections. Follows-up with insurance companies as well as medical providers and conducts or participates in 3rd party audit.
* Assists and supports Store Manager and Pharmacy Manager in analyzing and seeking to improve pharmacy financials, operational quality and customer service.
* Manages Community Outreach Portal and coordinates and, at the direction of the Pharmacy Manager, assigns pharmacists to off-site immunization clinics and community events. Builds and sustains relationships with retail partnerships.

**People & Performance Management**

* Leads performance management of technicians including making decisions and recommendations regarding discipline and termination. Follows constructive discipline policy to discipline, suspend, terminate or effectively recommend the same. Uses constructive discipline policy to ensure pharmacy technicians are compliant with state and federal laws. Holds technician accountable for attendance and timeliness. Maintains and improves performance of pharmacy through team member engagement and action planning.
* Accountable for technician hiring, on-boarding, training, and scheduling. Monitors and holds pharmacy technicians accountable for timely training completion. Follows established policies and procedures set by the company for scheduling and training.
* Accountable for identifying gaps in pharmacy operations knowledge among team members and supporting those team members in their training, either through hands-on training or assignment of learning modules.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager in monitoring that all pharmacy and team member licensures, registrations and certifications are active and in good standing/ compliant with all regulatory and legal requirements. Leverages Walgreens resources such as Walgreens Online Verification System to assist in documenting licensure status.
* Ensures proper procedures are followed for selection, recruitment, record retention, and trainin

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title: **Project Manager**

Location: **Hayward, CA**

Annual Salary Range: **$80,000 to $100,000 DOE**

### **JOB SUMMARY**

The Project Manager independently oversees and manages all phases of project development, including product sizing and selection, quotations, order processing, material tracking, project timelines, and stakeholder communication. This support enables Outside Sales Engineers (OSEs) to dedicate at least 60% of their efforts to external, client-facing activities.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Sales Responsibilities**

* Escalate and manage expedited orders with urgency and ensure manufacturer lead times are actively monitored and communicated.
* Keep Outside Sales Engineers (OSEs) and customers updated on delivery schedule changes using information from internal and external sources.
* Ensure order entry accuracy, align sales and factory purchase orders with submittals and customer purchase orders, and involve OSEs as necessary.
* Maintain and update Salesforce daily for accurate opportunity tracking and status updates.
* Communicate opportunity line-level status within active commercial quotations in Salesforce and use the Chatter function to keep all involved parties informed.

**General Responsibilities**

* Communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, with customers and staff.
* Foster cooperative working relationships with CHC staff.

Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Life Science, Advanced Tech, Healthcare
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, technically demanding construction projects across advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, and other specialized markets.

This is an opportunity for an established construction leader who enjoys taking ownership of challenging projects, leading high-performing teams, building strong client relationships, and delivering exceptional results. Ideal candidates will bring experience managing large-scale projects or multiple smaller projects in environments such as advanced technology facilities, semiconductor manufacturing, data centers, life sciences laboratories, pharmaceutical facilities, hospitals, medical centers, and other complex institutional or technical projects.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will have direct responsibility for all aspects of one large, complex project or multiple small-to-mid-sized projects. You will lead projects through every phase of the construction lifecycle, including estimating, purchasing, engineering, accounting, construction, safety, and quality assurance.

This role requires strong technical knowledge, sound business judgment, advanced problem-solving abilities, and the ability to identify and mitigate project risks. Equally important is the ability to develop, mentor, and lead project teams while building lasting relationships with clients, design partners, and key trade partners.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead new project pursuits, including the development and management of proposals, schedules, and cost estimates. Play an active role in business development activities.
* Provide leadership and expertise in design-build, design-assist, and other alternative project delivery methods.
* Plan and execute the bidding process for new projects, ensuring thorough subcontractor coverage, accurate pricing, and effective risk assessment and mitigation.
* Develop and manage conceptual and detailed estimates throughout preconstruction and construction, including GMP estimates and internal project budgets.
* Negotiate and develop contracts that protect the company's interests, minimize unnecessary risk, and maximize fee opportunities.
* Lead subcontractor selection, buyout, and contract negotiations, including the development and execution of subcontract agreements.
* Oversee all aspects of project management across complex or multiple projects, including estimating, preconstruction, procurement, submittals, change orders, RFIs, budgeting, financial reporting, cost forecasting, billing, scheduling, quality control, and project closeout.
* Proactively identify challenges, resolve project issues, and implement solutions that keep projects on track.
* Ensure permits, inspections, testing, and procurement activities are properly coordinated to prevent schedule delays.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, owners' representatives, design teams, subcontractors, and project stakeholders. Lead owner, architect, and contractor (OAC) meetings and maintain consistent communication throughout the project.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve project efficiency through construction technology, sustainability, Lean practices, and self-perform work.
* Collaborate closely with Superintendents and field management to plan, organize, and direct site activities while resolving field challenges.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop project staff, supporting their professional growth and overall team performance.
* Uphold company values, policies, procedures, ethics, and professionalism.
* Champion project safety by reinforcing safety policies, participating in safety meetings, and ensuring safety standards and practices are consistently maintained.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant construction experience.
* 10+ years of progressive construction project management experience.
* Strong project portfolio within one or more of the following sectors: advanced technology, semiconductor, data centers, mission-critical facilities, healthcare, hospitals, OSHPD/HCAI, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, laboratories, GMP, BSL, process piping, operating rooms, surgery centers, or medical centers.
* Experience managing technically complex, MEP-intensive construction projects.
* Proficiency with construction scheduling, budgeting, estimating, and project management software.
* Ability to develop, manage, and maintain detailed project schedules.
* OSHA 10 certification required. LEED AP and/or DBIA certifications preferred.
* Experience negotiating and developing contracts that protect the company's interests.
* Experience overseeing complex construction projects from preconstruction through completion.
* Demonstrated success delivering projects on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards and client expectations.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, leadership, and team development skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with conceptual estimating, budgeting, and unit cost development.
* Experience leading subcontractor selection, buyout, and contract negotiations.
* Experience managing complex or multiple construction projects, including estimating, procurement, submittals, RFIs, change orders, financial reporting, scheduling, quality control, and closeout.
* Experience with construction technology, sustainability, Lean practices, and self-perform work.
* Demonstrated ability to lead project teams and effectively manage client, subcontractor, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience working in occupied facilities or around active operations.
* Experience coordinating architects, engineers, owners, subcontractors, and specialty vendors.
* Experience with constructability reviews and value engineering.
* LEED AP and/or DBIA certification

jobs.title: Project Manager 3
jobs.description:
**JOB** **TITLE****:** Project Manager 3  
**FLSA:** Exempt position  
**LOCATION**: Fremont, CA (Onsite)  
**SALARY**: $85,000 - $130,000

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Project Manager (Level 3) serves as a technical and execution lead across multiple manufacturing projects, providing direction, expertise, and problem-solving leadership in complex or high-impact situations. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, drives alignment across cross-functional teams, and supports Program Managers by translating strategic objectives into executable plans. Level 3 Project Managers are trusted advisors on project execution and actively guide and coach junior Project Managers to strengthen overall team performance.

  

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and Operations teams.

* Lead execution of multiple projects concurrently, including complex Mass Production (MP) and/or New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives.

* Provide technical and execution leadership by defining project strategies, timelines, and risk mitigation plans.

* Identify systemic risks, resource constraints, and interdependencies across projects; recommend and implement corrective actions.

* Serve as an escalation point for project issues, leading root cause analysis and recovery planning.

* Lead critical project meetings and reviews, ensuring clear decision-making, accountability, and follow-through.

* Support customer- and headquarters-facing discussions as needed, providing execution insight and feasibility input.

* Partner closely with Program Managers to support program-level planning, prioritization, and execution strategy.

* Provide hands-on guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Level 1 and Level 2 Project Managers, including review of schedules, risk plans, and communications.

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management standards, tools, and best practices across the PM team.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Deep understanding of manufacturing project lifecycles and cross-functional dependencies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects independently with minimal oversight.
* Strong execution judgment with the ability to balance competing priorities and make timely decisions.
* Excellent leadership, influence, and stakeholder management skills without formal authority.
* Advanced problem-solving and risk management capabilities.
* Strong mentoring and coaching skills with a track record of developing junior team members.
* Clear, confident communication skills suitable for senior stakeholders and cross-functional leadership.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* 5–7 years of experience in project or program management within manufacturing, engineering, or operations environments.
* Proven experience leading multiple concurrent projects and mentoring less-experienced Project Managers.

jobs.title: Plumbing Service Project Manager
jobs.description:
Therma, a Legence company
  
For over 50 years, Therma has continued to redefine the mechanical construction landscapes in California. Renowned for outstanding client service and attention to detail, we balance innovative, facility-specific solutions with a pragmatic, cost-conscious approach. Today, the firm employs more than 1,100 people in 3 regional offices, and its clients represent a diverse range of market sectors, including Biopharmaceutical, Education, Healthcare, Food & Beverage, Commercial, Industrial and Data Center facilities. Our culture is open, innovative, collaborative, and fun – all reflected in recognition of Therma as a #1 Best Place to Work on multiple occasions. We create an environment that empowers & challenges employees, giving them the greatest opportunity to succeed.
  
  
Plumbing Service Project Manager
  
**Location:** San Jose, CA
  
**Job Type:** Full-time, In-Office
  
**Remote Option:** Not Available
  
  
Therma has an immediate need for an experienced Plumbing Service Project Manager based out of our San Jose office. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys managing fast-paced service work, building strong customer relationships, and taking ownership of projects from initial scope and estimate through execution and closeout.
  
The Plumbing Service Project Manager will oversee a variety of plumbing service projects, ranging from smaller repair and maintenance work to larger, more complex projects. You'll work directly with customers to understand their needs, develop scopes of work, prepare estimates and budgets, coordinate labor and materials, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and profitably.
  
This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once. Above all, you'll serve as a trusted partner to our customers and help ensure a high level of service and customer satisfaction.
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Manage plumbing service projects from initial customer request and estimating through execution, billing, and closeout.
* Develop scopes of work, budgets, estimates, proposals, and project schedules.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and serve as a primary point of contact throughout the project.
* Identify customer needs, develop service opportunities, follow up on leads, and support ongoing account growth.
* Coordinate and lead project teams, field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and internal resources as needed.
* Prepare budget projections, maintain accurate cost forecasts, and manage projects to established revenue and profitability goals.
* Track labor hours, material costs, equipment, subcontractor costs, and overall project performance.
* Estimate, prepare, and manage change orders and communicate changes clearly to customers and project teams.
* Procure materials and equipment and coordinate delivery based on project schedules and field requirements.
* Review drawings, specifications, submittals, and other project documentation; redline or mark up drawings as needed.
* Attend customer meetings, site walks, and project meetings and maintain regular communication with the field and customer.
* Troubleshoot technical and operational issues and work collaboratively with field teams to develop practical solutions.
* Identify existing plumbing systems that may not meet current plumbing codes and develop recommendations and estimates for corrective work.
* Support plumbing service and preventative maintenance needs, including storm, sewer, grease waste, and related plumbing systems.
* Apply value-engineering principles and identify opportunities to improve project execution, cost, and customer outcomes.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, contracts, change orders, forecasts, and other required project records.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to project and field teams while reinforcing accountability, safety, quality, and Therma's project management standards and procedures.

Required Qualifications
  

* 5+ years of experience in commercial plumbing, mechanical construction, or plumbing service, with demonstrated responsibility for managing projects, customers, budgets, and/or field operations.
* Strong working knowledge of commercial plumbing systems, service, repair, installation, and preventative maintenance.
* Ability to scope and estimate plumbing service and corrective work.
* Working knowledge of applicable plumbing codes and the ability to recognize existing conditions that may require corrective action.
* Experience managing project budgets, cost projections, change orders, labor, materials, and project profitability.
* Strong customer relationship and communication skills with the ability to confidently interact with building owners, facility teams, contractors, vendors, and field personnel.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and service requests simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot field and project issues and drive them to resolution.

jobs.description:
**FAMILY SUPPORT SERVICES**

JOB ANNOUNCEMENT

Bilingual (Spanish/English) Respite Care Coordinator

**Location**

Oakland, California | 303 Hegenberger Road, Suite 400

**Department**

Respite

**Status / Schedule**

Non- Exempt, Full-time, 37.5 hours per week; occasional evenings and weekends

**Annual compensation**

$53,000–$58,000, inclusive of eligible bilingual differential

ABOUT FAMILY SUPPORT SERVICES

Family Support Services (FSS) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening families and supporting children, youth, and caregivers. With offices in San Francisco and Oakland, FSS provides prevention, intervention, respite, and childcare services in the communities we serve.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Bilingual Respite Care Coordinator helps families access authorized respite and child care services through referral intake, scheduling, family-provider matching, documentation, and follow-up. Using a trauma-informed, culturally responsive, family-centered approach, the Coordinator works with families, providers, and department staff to support timely service delivery, accurate records, and effective communication. The ideal candidate is comfortable with technology, thinks critically when problems arise, works toward clear goals, and collaborates well with a team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Support referrals, intake, enrollment, and follow-up; explain program requirements, approved services, and next steps to families

· Assess family needs and provider availability, facilitate appropriate matches, and follow up to resolve routine scheduling or service barriers; elevate unresolved or sensitive matters promptly.

· Maintain confidential case notes, client/provider files, reports, and tracking records; follow up on missing forms, timesheets, and other service documentation.

SCHEDULING AND AUTHORIZED SERVICES

· Obtain, enter, update, and coordinate family and provider schedules; follow up on missing or changed information.

· Track approved service hours and use within authorization limits; identify cancellations, discrepancies, and unfilled services.

· Resolve routine scheduling questions and conflicts independently; analyze barriers or authorization changes, propose solutions, and elevate issues that need follow-up.

· Maintain organized scheduling and service records so pending needs and interruptions can be addressed.

· Work toward program goals for new client enrollment, client service hours, and successful family-provider matches; track progress and raise barriers to meeting goals early.

Documentation, reporting, and outreach

· Complete assigned reports and follow-up on missing forms, timesheets, service documentation, and electronic system records.

· Participate in assigned outreach, resource events, and provider recruitment; share approved bilingual program information.

· Track outreach contacts and referrals; communicate service concerns and progress to department leadership.

Team support, backup care, and safety

· Collaborate with the Supervisor, Director, senior program staff, and team members to meet shared program goals; share information proactively, cover for teammates when needed, and participate in training and cross-training.

· Provide backup respite or child care when trained and assigned; support children’s developmental, behavioral, and safety needs.

· Follow confidentiality, health and safety, and mandated-reporting procedures; promptly report incidents or significant concerns.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

· Professional bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English, including clear verbal and written communication with families and colleagues.

· At least two years of relevant family support, respite, child care, human services, or community program experience, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

· Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through; demonstrated ability to set priorities, meet goals and deadlines, and use sound judgment to solve problems.

· Strong computer skills, including Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams), databases or case-management systems, electronic timekeeping, and online program portals; able to learn new software quickly and solve basic technical issues independently.

· Valid California driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, reliable transportation, current registration, and auto insurance.

· Ability to meet background-clearance, training, mandated-reporting, and direct-service requirements; flexibility for occasional evening and weekend assignments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

· Bachelor’s degree in human services, social services, child development, psychology, sociology, family studies, education, or related field.

· Experience working with children, foster families, caregivers, individuals with disabilities, or community-based programs.

· Experience coordinating respite or child care schedules, authorizations, and provider relationships.

Candidates with applicable experience are encouraged to apply even if they do not hold a bachelor’s degree.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Salary: $53,000–$58,000 annually, depending on qualifications and experience. Employees meeting FSS bilingual proficiency requirements and qualifying under agency policy are eligible for a $1,200 annual bilingual differential. This differential is included within the advertised salary range, not added on top of it. Eligible employees receive benefits under current agency plans, including health and dental coverage, optional benefits, retirement benefits, and paid vacation, sick, and personal time.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Graspmore Physical Therapy is a boutique orthopedic and sports PT clinic in Potrero Hill. We’re looking for a polished, people-loving front desk professional to be the first voice and face our patients meet. You’ll check patients in and out, keep their care on track, and make every visit feel personal.

The role is roughly 75% front desk and patient experience and 25% social media and marketing. You’ll help shape how Graspmore shows up online by coming up with content ideas, creating posts, and sharing the stories that happen in our clinic every day.

This role is a great fit for people combining part-time roles into a full schedule, people exploring a career in healthcare, and mature final-year students with a light class load. If you love this kind of work and don’t see yourself on that list, we still want to hear from you.

We’re building for the long term. A commitment of at least 9 months is strongly preferred, and we reward people who stay.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in front desk, healthcare, medicine, or wellness
* Confident handling payments and talking through costs with warmth
* Available to work 20 hours across three weekdays
* Must be 18+ and able to pass a pre-employment background check

**Nice to Have**

* Digital marketing or social media experience
* Comfortable creating content for Instagram, Facebook, and Google
* A creative eye and ideas you’re excited to try

**Pay**

* $27–32/hour, depending on experience
* $500 retention bonus at 6 months, $1,000 at 12 months
* Clear path to full-time after 6–12 months

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Love being around people all day and it shows
* Take pride in running a tight, organized front desk
* Stay calm and kind when the phone, the desk, and the waiting room all need you at once
* Notice the small things, like a patient who hasn’t rebooked or a form that’s missing
* Have a creative streak and enjoy telling a brand’s story
* Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

**What You’ll Do**

*Front Desk & Patient Experience (about 75%)*

* Welcome patients and create a warm, personal first impression
* Check patients in and out, rebook follow-ups, and help them commit to their plan of care
* Answer calls, emails, and texts promptly
* Process payments and superbills, and explain our out-of-network process
* Review intake paperwork before visits
* Fill cancellations, manage the waitlist, and follow up with patients who’ve fallen off
* Celebrate patient milestones and keep the front office stocked and organized

*Social Media & Marketing (about 25%)*

* Brainstorm and pitch social media content ideas
* Create, schedule, and post content across Instagram, Facebook, and Google Business
* Capture clinic moments, patient wins, and team culture (with consent)
* Support marketing campaigns, promotions, and community events

**Perks**

* Paid sick time and paid holidays
* Free gym access during off hours
* Team lunches, happy hours, and quarterly team events
* Mentorship from a team that invests in its people

*Graspmore will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*

Pay: $27.00 - $32.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flextime
* Free parking
* Happy hour
* On-site gym
* On-the-job training
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Wellness program

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 2+ years of experience in front desk, healthcare, medicine, or wellness?
* Are you looking for a role you can stay in for at least 9 months?

Our TruCytes cell mimics precisely replicate real cells' optical and biochemical properties - without the sourcing, quality, or cost challenges of traditional controls. Trusted in cell-based applications across cell therapy, drug development, and diagnostics, they empower process and analytical development, quality control, potency assessments, multi-site validations, clinical research studies, and assay development and validation.

Slingshot is seeking motivated, creative team members who think outside the box. We empower employees to own their work, contribute ideas quickly, and improve processes. Come join our cross-disciplinary and world-class team that is delivering game-changing solutions for cell-based applications!

jobs.title: Compliance Assurance Program Manager
jobs.description:
The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. TPRM covers the safeguards that govern how third parties (developers, partners, vendors and service providers) access, use and protect Meta user data. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. As well as an individual contributor who tackles privacy complexities head-on, to help design and build an comprehensive privacy compliance program, while keeping our users and their privacy at the forefront of everything that we do.  
  
  

### **Compliance Assurance Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the second-line compliance partner for TPRM safeguards across the whole third-party lifecycle: onboarding and due diligence, contract and platform terms, data access and API permissions, ongoing monitoring, enforcement, and offboarding and data deletion
* Lead FTC Consent Order Assessment readiness for assigned TPRM safeguards: coordinate assessor requests, review populations, samples and evidence, and own response narratives through to delivery
* Support Meta's commitment to protect users' privacy by enabling and advising privacy domains to navigate the complex landscape of global and data privacy regulations
* Advise on how new third-party integrations and platform capabilities affect Meta's privacy posture, and safeguards/controls
* Provide independent oversight to proactively identify issues, ensure visibility, and help prioritize remediation efforts within assigned safeguards/domains, acting as a key escalation point and advocate for risk mitigation
* Develop long-term objectives of how we will evolve our privacy program operating model with well-documented roadmaps, goals, and objectives while delivering on immediate priorities

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
Beginnings matter. Whether someone is starting their career or joining a new company, their early experiences shape how quickly they find their footing and how far they can go. A great beginning gives people the context, skills, and confidence to do their best work.

As our **Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager,** you’ll own that moment for nearly everyone who joins Mercury, across new hire onboarding, internships, and a new apprenticeship program. You’ll think as deeply about the experience people have as the systems behind the scenes that make it all work, and you’ll be a visible face of Mercury when people need support most. You’ll build programs that feel distinctly Mercury, using AI and your creativity to rethink how they work from the ground up.

* *Mercury is a financial technology company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

### **Here are some things you’ll do on the job:**

* **Run new hire onboarding.** Own the program end to end: the learning arc, facilitator coordination, cohort communications, and feedback. Partner with People Operations on preboarding so the experience starts before day one and every new hire’s first weeks feel useful and welcoming.
* **Launch our new apprenticeship program.** Design and own program operations and the apprentice experience: cohort programming, exec exposure, check-ins at each rotation, and partnerships with host teams.
* **Strengthen our internship program.** Build on what teams already run with a shared company-wide experience for interns, including onboarding, community, regular check-ins, and a clear point of contact.
* **Support managers and mentors.** Give the people hosting new hires, interns, and apprentices clear expectations and the resources to do it well.
* **Build the systems behind the programs.** Use AI, automation, and tooling to reimagine what each program can do, keep quality high as hiring grows, and adapt as the technology evolves. Use feedback and data to see what’s working and improve it.
* **Tell the story of emerging talent.** Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, and leaders across Mercury to show how we invest in people early in their careers.

### **You should:**

* Have **3–5 years of experience** building and running programs, ideally in Learning & Development, People programs, early-career talent, or onboarding.
* Be an **excellent program manager**. You turn ideas into plans, keep many moving pieces organized, and follow through from launch to iteration.
* Be a **skilled facilitator.** You’ve led sessions or trainings and can turn what people need to know into something they learn.
* **Be hands-on with AI.** You experiment with new tools, know when they help, and use them to rethink what our programs can do.
* **Think in systems.** You spot themes across pain points, trace them back to how the program is designed, and solve them systematically.
* Be **creative and comfortable with ambiguity**. Some programs are established, some are new, and you’re energized by figuring out what fits Mercury.
* Be a **clear, warm communicator**. You can welcome someone on day one, run a room, and write a crisp message. You own the details, ask good questions, and stay open to changing your mind.

Experience with **early-career, university, internship, apprenticeship, or employee onboarding programs** is a strong plus.

### **Location and on-site expectations**

This role is hybrid and based in **San Francisco**, home of our apprenticeship program. You’ll spend time in the office with our apprentices and join workshops, programming, and other in-person moments. You’ll also support interns in San Francisco and New York, some in person and some remotely.
