jobs.title: Scaled Account Manager, Beneficial Deployments
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Nonprofits, universities and other mission-driven organizations do some of the hardest work in the world, usually with small teams and little technical capacity. As a Scaled Account Manager in Beneficial Deployments, you will be the person a named book of these organizations can rely on. You will own each customer relationship after the first conversation, including commercials, activation and the conversations that turn a new deployment into everyday use.

This role sits on the Scaled Sales team within Beneficial Deployments, the part of Anthropic that brings Claude to mission-driven organizations sooner and further than the market would on its own. You will work with little to no dedicated Customer Success support, so you are both the seller and the person who helps a customer get real value.

That is only possible if you work differently. You will use Claude to take on the short-horizon tasks that consume a book like this, and spend your time on strategic conversations. The role will also change. As we automate more of this work, the book will take less of your time, and that time moves to growth: deeper work with your highest-potential accounts, launches, events and programs that reach many more organizations. We are hiring someone who wants that: someone who will automate parts of their own job and move on to the next hard problem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own a named book of nonprofit and education customers.** Take over existing relationships and run them end to end: retention, seat growth, plan moves and new contacts inside each organization.
* **Drive activation yourself.** Help priority customers in the segment go from purchased seats to weekly use, starting with where staff lose the most time: fundraising, grant writing, reporting and program operations at nonprofits, or research support, teaching and administration in higher ed.
* **Automate your own work.** Use Claude to handle account research, follow-ups, usage reviews and routine questions, then share what works so the whole team can use it.
* **Spend your time on strategic conversations.** Work with executive directors, operations leads, and IT and academic leaders at universities to find the use cases that matter to their mission and agree what success looks like.
* **Spot who is ready for more.** Identify customers moving from individual productivity toward redesigned workflows, build the case, and bring in Applied AI or other specialists when they qualify for deeper support.
* **Build programs, not one-offs.** When ten customers have the same problem, create a playbook, webinar or cohort that solves it once.
* **Be the voice of your book.** Bring what you hear to Product, Marketing, Support and Operations, and work across those teams to get customer problems fixed.

**Where your time goes as we automate**
---------------------------------------

The role starts mostly account-facing. Over roughly the first six months, we expect Claude to take on much of the routine work, and your time shifts toward growth. Examples of where it goes:

* **Deeper with priority accounts.** Spend real time with the 10 to 15% of your book that can move from individual productivity to redesigned workflows, and get them there.
* **Quarterly launches.** Beneficial Deployments brings new offerings to the nonprofit and education community each quarter. Help drive them: coordinate across Marketing, Comms and partner teams, and make sure your customers benefit.
* **Events.** Help shape and run the events, local and eventually international, that become a core part of how we reach new organizations.
* **New signups and scaled partnerships.** Contribute to the motions that bring new organizations onto Claude, including partner channels and programs for segments we don't yet serve well.

The exact mix will change, and you will help decide it. Part of the job is working out which tasks should be automated and which still deserve a person's time.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
-------------------------------------

* 3+ years of account management or customer success experience with nonprofit or higher education customers, with a proven track record of growing retention and driving adoption of new technology
* Have owned customer relationships in an account management or customer success role, and can point to accounts you grew, retained or turned around

jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services

jobs.title: Bilingual Community Health Navigator II- San Francisco
jobs.description:
### Position Title: Community Health Navigator II

**Department**: Operations

**Reports To**: ECM Territory Manager

**Location**: Hybrid/ Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-time

**Travel requirement:** This is a field-based position and requires substantial travel to meet with members where they live.

**About MedZed**
----------------

MedZed is a leader in delivering value-based, technology-enabled social support to a diverse population of high-cost Medicaid members who have been unreachable with telephonic outreach, disconnected from primary care, and using hospital-based services as their primary point of care. We combine innovative technologies with field-based outreach to find and engage these members. We then apply a model of care designed to re-connect them to primary care, address the Health-Related Social Needs (HRSNs) that contribute to their disengagement and present barriers to care, and provide them with the means and knowledge to take more control over their healthcare. Our interventions yield reduced Emergency Department and Inpatient utilization costs for our health plan partners and improved quality of life for their members.

### **Primary Focus:**

Independent field-based case management for moderate-to-high acuity members. To be effective, associates in this position will spend a substantial part of the work week visiting and enrolling members in the community.

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

**The Community Health Navigator II (CHN II) is an ECM care manager responsible for managing complex and high-acuity member cases, serving as a mentor to newly hired care team staff, and modeling excellence in engagement, documentation, and compliance performance. The CHN II role is focused on developing foundational care coordination skills. CHN IIs are responsible for outreach (via door knocks and telephone), assessments, quality and billable care delivery and member graduations in compliance with CalAIM, DHCS, and contracted health plan requirements.** **This role is non-clinical in nature and is an in-field position minimum 4 days a week.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Manage an ECM caseload up to 50+ members.
* Complete initial and follow-up ECM assessments including Primary, Secondary, PHQ-9, and required reassessments.
* Support development and updates of individualized Care Plans
* Calls, field visits, and door knock to provide care and enroll new members.
* Build and maintain a member panel through consistent outreach.
* Coordinate referrals to health plans, providers, and community-based resources.
* Staff tables and other community partnership opportunities as requested.
* Document timely, accurate, and compliant case notes in Salesforce Health Cloud and health plan portals, as necessary.
* Participate in interdisciplinary case conferences and team huddles
* Escalate complex or high-risk member needs appropriately.
* Maintain compliance with CalAIM, DHCS, and health plan requirements.
* Meet outreach, engagement, and documentation standards.
* Attend required training and professional development.
* Support audit readiness and data tracking activities.
* Comply with all company policies and administrative requirements

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* 2+ years’ experience in ECM, case management, or community health
* Demonstrated excellence in documentation and compliance.
* Ability to manage complex psychosocial and medical needs.
* Curious and relentless nature
* Commitment to do outreach via phone and in-person to enroll new members.

**Internal Promotion Criteria (CHN II CHN III):**

* Serve as a CHN II for a minimum of 12 months.
* Maintain engagement, outreach, panel size, and quality metrics for at least six consecutive months.
* Be in good standing with no active corrective action.

Description:

### **Position Summary:**

The Training Specialist I is responsible for delivering high-impact, equity-driven training within the organization and with external partners to support Roots’ mission of uplifting and empowering high-priority, marginalized communities. Operating under the supervision of the Roots Training Manager, this role focuses on preparing, facilitating, and evaluating comprehensive training programs. This includes supporting the delivery of foundational classroom curriculum for the Community Health Worker (CHW) program, assisting with administering standard Workforce Development training, and facilitating sessions for specialized certifications like Adult Mental Health First Aid. By collaborating with subject matter experts and program managers, the Training Specialist I ensures all staff, trainees, and partners are equipped with the pedagogical, clinical, and interpersonal competencies required to mitigate social determinants of health (SDOH).

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Training Delivery & Facilitation:** Conduct dynamic, interactive training sessions using diverse instructional methodologies that emphasize repetition, peer-to-peer modules, and active student "teach-backs".
* **CHW Curriculum Execution:** Facilitate the 45-to-48-hour classroom training footprint across core instructional dimensions, including client engagement, behavioral health, trauma-informed care, and toxic stress analysis.
* **Universal Training Administration:** Lead the execution of Roots Universal Training modules required for organizational onboarding:
  + *Roots History:* Anchoring new employee hires in the organization's mission, values, and community rituals.
  + *Epidemiology:* Introducing localized health disparities and health literacy trends within target zones like East Oakland.
  + *Interpersonal/Professional Skills:* Delivering the Professionalism Suite to cultivate workplace success, boundary setting, and compliance standards.
* **Mental Health First Aid Integration:** Conduct protocol-driven training and certifications in Adult Mental Health First Aid to prepare participants to respond to acute psychiatric and substance use crises.
* **Workforce Development Support:** Support specialized workforce initiatives to transition staff and community members into sustainable healthcare careers, reinforcing the CHW track as a lifelong professional path.
* **Collaborative Design & Adaptability:** Partner with subject matter experts to adapt instructional content to align with the Community Health Worker national standard frameworks.
* **MAA & Regulatory Literacy Integration:** Incorporate knowledge of Medi-Cal Administrative Activities (MAA) billing, state Medi-Cal eligibility navigation, complex care management, and mandatory reporting laws into routine instruction.
* **Impact Evaluation & Record Keeping:** Assist in evaluating training efficacy through mock office simulations and structured assessments, maintaining precise tracking systems for trainee participation, hours credit, and completion records.
* **Administrative Support:** Attend department and staff meetings as necessary to align instruction with broader Learning standard operating procedures.

Requirements:

### **Core Competencies:**

* **Presentation & Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills; demonstrated ability to guide group discussions, manage professional environments, and lead community rituals.
* **Clinical/Community Framework Experience:** Proven experience implementing training within a clinical setting, healthcare navigation network, or community health framework.
* **Technical & Regulatory Proficiency:** Comfort utilizing e-learning platforms, digital tools, and electronic medical records navigation systems, while preserving critical ethical standards such as HIPAA and the ADA.
* **Project Management & Collaboration:** Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to manage multiple training cohorts, deadlines, and pre-designed curricula simultaneously.
* **Cultural Humility & Adaptability:** Ability to pivot delivery based on stakeholder needs, maintaining a firm commitment to empowering communities of African and Indigenous descent.

We believe engineers do their best work when they keep building their skills, can see a clear path ahead, and have the support to strengthen their technical leadership. We develop engineers at every stage of their careers through technical training, technical career development, and technical leadership programs. When we grow our engineers, we grow our future.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Staff Technical Development Program Manager to own technical development programs from end to end, from design through execution and evaluation. You will thrive in a fast-moving, global environment.

Hands-on experience running technical training, career development, or leadership programs end to end.

**Program Execution and Operations**

* Analytical mindset: defines success metrics, drafts surveys, and uses participant, mentor, and manager data to evaluate and improve programs; builds roadmaps, practical governance, and measurable outcomes aligned with engineering strategy.

jobs.title: Security & EHS Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Our collective future depends on carbon-free transportation. To forge that future, Voltera develops, owns, and operates the infrastructure that enables companies to succeed at scale with zero-emission vehicles. We're looking for innovative, people-first team members who understand that culture is critical in our effort to positively impact the world's transition to a carbon-free transportation future.

Voltera is seeking a Security & EHS Operations Manager to lead day-to-day security and environmental, health, and safety (EHS) operations across all of Voltera's workplace and commercial locations nationwide. This is a hands-on, full-time role, not a purely strategic one: you will directly supervise the Security Desk and embedded security staff, own the technology that runs physical security day to day, and build out the data and reporting function that gives leadership visibility into both programs.

You should be comfortable working hands-on with security-specific technology and systems on a daily basis, and equally comfortable managing the outsourced EHS expertise that supports workplace safety and the environmental requirements that come with operating EV charging sites. You don't need to be the technical EHS expert yourself; you need to understand the requirements well enough to manage that vendor relationship and make sure its guidance translates into real execution on the ground. This role also partners closely with the teams supporting a site's full development lifecycle — Real Estate, Development, and Construction — with People Operations and Workplace teams supporting Voltera's distributed worker base, and with customer security and safety teams at partner locations.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

**Security Operations**

* Directly supervise 24/7 Security Desk operations, including scheduling, performance, and day-to-day direction of embedded security staff.
* Own and operate Voltera's core security technology stack nationwide — access control & badging systems, video management systems (VMS), and visitor management systems — including user provisioning, credentialing, and system health.
* Coordinate incident response, investigations, and post-incident reporting across all locations.
* Manage third-party physical security consulting engagements, including scope, deliverables, and program design and execution.
* Evaluate and expand security coverage models — embedded staffing, technology, and patrol — as new and newly acquired sites come online.
* Own security-related vendor budgets, invoicing, and SOW/PO administration.

**Data & Reporting (Security + EHS)**

* Own the data and reporting function for both security and EHS programs, building and maintaining the metrics, dashboards, and reporting cadence leadership uses to track both — pulling in vendor-supplied data as a key input.
* Serve as the source of truth for security and EHS KPIs — incidents, access activity, audit findings, and vendor performance — across the nationwide portfolio.
* Standardize status reporting and escalation flags so open issues in either function surface quickly.

**Work Order & Vendor Coordination (Security + EHS)**

* Issue and manage work orders for security device service calls — access control, cameras, visitor management hardware, and alarm systems — through Voltera's CMMS.
* Issue and manage work orders for safety and environmental equipment inspections and servicing — fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, eyewash stations, AEDs, spill kits, and similar life-safety and environmental equipment.
* Coordinate with the Facilities team on incidents that require facility repairs — damaged doors, gates, locks, or other physical damage resulting from a security or EHS event.
* Manage vendor relationships and SLAs for security and EHS equipment maintenance, inspection, and repair, tracking completion alongside other security and EHS KPIs.

**EHS Operations**

* Own and manage the vendor relationship and platform — Voltera's primary source of EHS technical expertise — and lead its expansion to commercial sites nationwide.
* Serve as the operational point of contact for EHS-specific vendors and software tools, translating their technical guidance into day-to-day execution across the portfolio.
* Partner with EHS vendors to maintain compliance with OSHA and applicable state/local workplace safety regulations across all workplace and commercial locations.
* Leverage vendor expertise to manage environmental compliance requirements across the portfolio — hazardous materials handling, spill prevention and control (SPCC) plans, stormwater management, and environmental permitting related to charging equipment, battery storage, and backup power systems — ensuring vendor recommendations are implemented on the ground.
* Coordinate with EHS vendors to develop and maintain emergency response, site evacuation, and spill/hazmat response plans, and lead staff training and drills.
* Lead safety and environmental incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action tracking, pulling in vendor expertise where technical review is needed.
* Coordinate recurring safety and environmental compliance audits and risk assessments nationwide, partnering with EHS vendors on technical assessment and ensuring findings are tracked to closure.

**Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with the Real Estate, Development, and Construction teams across a site's full development lifecycle — from pre-development through construction and into operations — to plan security and EHS requirements at each phase.
* Design and manage an integrated guarding strategy that makes the best use of vendor resources across project phases, from construction-site security through steady-state operational coverage.
* Partner with customer security teams at partner and host locations to improve information sharing and operational efficiencies.
* Partner with People Operations and Workplace teams to ensure safe and secure working environments

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Gigstreem is a US based national Internet Service Provider, serving Residential (Single Family, MDU) and Commercial (MTU) clients with technology solutions in markets across the country.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Project Manager leads end-to-end execution of residential capital project launches, including low voltage and network hardware installations for our managed WiFi solutions. Every project is delivered on time, within budget, and to client satisfaction.

The role works with cross-functional partners through every stage of the project lifecycle. That includes translating services sold into the Internal Statement of Work, developing and running the project plan, coordinating teams and clients, and leading the post-launch financial and operational review.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

Project Initiation & Planning

* Review and fully understand contract and pre-sale deliverables (Sales Budget, Scope of Work, Design, Circuit Provider plan, and revenue/conversion model) and translate services sold into the Internal Statement of Work.
* Develop comprehensive project plans for all assigned projects, including requirements, objectives, timelines, budgets, milestones, and resource allocation.
* Plan, manage, and execute projects involving low voltage cabling and network hardware installations.

Project Plan & Schedule Management

* Create and update the project plan and schedule covering all in-scope items, tasks, responsibilities, and due dates.
* Ensure each phase closes only after all deliverables are submitted.
* Ensure all tasks and activities are QC’ed by the appropriate subject matter expert (SME).
* Ensure punch-list completion and submission of all closeout materials.
* Schedule and run closeout meetings and guide stakeholders through the Lessons Learned process.

Team Leadership & Coordination

* Supervise and coordinate internal teams (CSM, Engineering, Design, Sales, Leadership), subcontractors, and vendors to achieve project goals.
* Delegate and assign responsibilities; direct, motivate, and manage all project work and resources, ensuring efficient use of company resources.
* Run regular project meetings and other communication channels so all stakeholders know their updates and responsibilities.
* Mentor and guide new hires and other members of the PM team.

Technical Management

* Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of low voltage systems (structured cabling, fiber optics) and network hardware (routers, switches, access points).
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the project lifecycle, using company resources and management as needed.

Client Engagement

* Serve as the primary point of contact for ownership clients and property managers.
* Provide regular project and construction updates, including progress reports, milestones, and risk assessments.
* Address client concerns promptly and professionally.

Budget & Resource Management

* Prepare and track project budgets, review financial information, and enforce cost controls to promote profitability.
* Manage procurement of equipment, materials, and resources required for installations.
* Review and approve project-related expenses, invoices, and change orders.
* Monitor accounts receivable and assist with collections as necessary.
* Lead the post-launch financial and operational review.

Compliance, Quality & Documentation

* Ensure the Construction Manager conducts site inspections to verify work quality and adherence to company standards.
* Ensure proper documentation of installations, configurations, and as-built drawings.
* Oversee all project documentation, including milestone and task status, internal and external reports, and executive summaries.
* Produce reporting for cross-functional managers to ensure company policies are followed.

Risk Management

* Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Resolve conflicts or delays during execution and escalate issues as needed.

Process Improvement

* Evaluate business processes, procedures, and systems; develop and run improvement projects to drive efficiency and reduce cost.
* Work cross-functionally to develop, document, and implement guidelines, evaluations, recruitment, and promotion processes.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Telecommunications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience in tenant finish-out project management, expediting, and logistics management.
* Experience with inspections and regulatory compliance.

Technical Knowledge

* Strong understanding of structured cabling, fiber optics, and network hardware (routers, switches, access points).
* Knowledge of technologies and materials used in telecommunications site designs.
* Familiarity with industry standards and best practices (e.g., TIA/EIA, BICSI).
* Awareness of general accounting and costing practices, including budgeting, invoicing, purchase orders, and accounts payable.
* Proficient in project management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet) and technical documentation software (AutoCAD).
* Proficient in CRM, ERP, billing, and other enterprise systems, and in Microsoft Office (Project, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Strong leadership: giving direction, implementing action, and defining and measuring success, while working as part of a team.

jobs.description:
**Customer Program Manager**

**Modus Advanced, LLC**

**Location:** Remote

**Pay Range:** $75,000–$140,000, depending on experience

Full-Time, Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW

Modus Advanced is looking for a Customer Program Manager to own the full order execution lifecycle for our most strategic accounts in aerospace, defense, and commercial space. This is not a sales role. There is no quota, no pipeline to manage, and no prospecting. What there is: ownership, complexity, and high stakes.

You will drive orders from PO receipt to shipment for programs where schedule failures have real consequences — defense systems on critical paths, commercial space launch windows, and medical devices that cannot be late. You will coordinate across Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Pre-Production to keep programs moving, surface constraints before they become problems, and communicate with precision to customers who have zero tolerance for ambiguity.

The right person for this role has a project management or program management background in a manufacturing or technical environment. You are used to owning outcomes, not just tracking them. You know how to read a production schedule, understand lead time dynamics, and translate operational reality into clear, confidence-building communication for demanding customers.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Experience & Background

* 3–7 years of experience in a Program Manager, Customer Program Manager, Production Control, Supply Chain PM, Order Management, or similar role in a manufacturing or technical environment

jobs.title: Military Higher Education Program Manager
jobs.description:
Harkcon, Inc. is a service-disabled veteran-owned small business that helps federal organizations improve workforce performance, strengthen programs, modernize processes, and manage complex mission-support activities. We value sound judgment, clear communication, accountability, and practical solutions that help customers accomplish their missions.

We are seeking a P**rogram Manager** to support a military-affiliated higher education initiative serving geographically dispersed students. This role will coordinate academic program activities, institutional relationships, student and cohort tracking, communications, data quality, and leadership reporting while helping participants navigate education pathways that complement military training and career development.

**Location**: **This position is primarily at federal customer facilities in Norfolk, Virginia, and Washington, DC.**Remote work or telework is subject to government approval and is not guaranteed.

**\*\*\* This position is contingent upon award of a contract to Harkcon\*\*\***

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage schedules, milestones, risks, actions, deliverables, and communications for higher education and workforce-development initiatives.
* Coordinate with military organizations, colleges, program offices, academic partners, advisors, registrars, instructors, and student-support personnel.
* Track student cohorts, participation, course progress, completions, issues, requests, and required follow-up actions.
* Maintain accurate program databases, shared workspaces, correspondence logs, document repositories, and management reports.
* Support curriculum and course reviews, degree-pathway mapping, transfer-credit discussions, articulation activities, and alignment with workforce requirements.
* Develop guides, frequently asked questions, presentations, outreach materials, briefing products, and executive summaries.
* Manage program inboxes or service channels and ensure questions are researched, routed, answered, and documented promptly.
* Analyze participation, progression, completion, service-demand, and issue data to identify trends and recommend improvements.
* Support meetings, webinars, orientations, advising events, working groups, and program reviews.
* Create and maintain student databases and coordinate information with academic and government representatives.
* Evaluate cohort-tracking processes and recommend improvements that reduce redundant data entry and information gaps.
* Support implementation and maintenance of an automated education-management system.

**Required Qualifications**

* Four-year degree from an accredited college or university. Preferred fields include Business, Education, Public Administration, or a related discipline.
* At least three years of experience in project support, analysis, or administrative functions related to education or training programs.
* Experience tracking participants, cohorts, course activity, program actions, and performance data.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with academic, government, military, and operational stakeholders.
* Strong written communication, research, presentation, organization, and customer-service skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, databases, and structured tracking tools.
* Ability to protect student and personnel information and follow applicable records-management requirements.
* Ability to meet federal background-investigation, credentialing, and system-access requirements and remain **eligible to obtain a Secret security clearance.** An active clearance is not currently required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting military-connected students or military education programs.
* Knowledge of academic advising, student services, transfer credit, prior-learning assessment, curriculum mapping, articulation agreements, or institutional accreditation.
* Experience working with community colleges, universities, registrars, military training organizations, or credentialing bodies.
* Experience developing dashboards or reports using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.
* Project-management or higher education administration certification.
* Experience with data cleansing, metrics development, and performance tracking.

**Work Environment**

**This is a full-time position** which may support a distributed team through a combination of remote work and activities at federal customer locations. The employee must be able to participate in virtual and in-person meetings, work during normal customer business hours, travel periodically, and use customer-approved collaboration and information systems. Specific location, travel, and access requirements will be confirmed before placement.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Harkcon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

The Contact Center Supervisor is responsible for leading and supporting a high-performing team of customer service representatives during non-business hours. This role ensures the delivery of reliable, efficient, and high-quality support to customers by implementing strategic objectives, analyzing call center metrics, and driving continuous improvement. The Supervisor will coach and develop team members to maintain consistent service standards, foster a positive and professional work environment, and manage performance through regular feedback, attendance oversight, and disciplinary action when necessary.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  

* Implement objectives, analyze call center metrics, and ensure that the company and staff meet goals and provide reliable, efficient support for customers
* Manage a team of Customer Experience Representatives (CERs), providing development coaching, support and performance evaluation. Develop, coach, support and continually evaluate the teams performance, coaching customer service skills for quality assurance
* Foster and mentor a consistent positive, cooperative, courteous, and professional attitude
* Manage attendance.
* Administer disciplinary action, as necessary.
* Recognize and reward excellent team performance.
* Answering representative’s questions, guiding them through difficult calls or issues, diffusing angry customers, or handling issues that cannot be fielded by representatives.
* Leading team meetings, asking questions to better understand the calls representatives are receiving, educating, and coaching workers regarding processes and practices, and explain expectations to employees.
* Assisting other management team members in identifying trends and establishing call center goals
* Ensuring staff members are achieving desired service levels and taking corrective action, as needed · Preparing reports and analyzing call center data to improve processes, ensure resources are properly allocated, and maximize efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Taking on other tasks or projects to support employees, other managers, and call center operations.
* Develop standards, processes, procedures, and documentation to support quality and service goals involving triage and assignment of incoming calls to closing a call with a satisfied customer.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**What you bring:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or 5 years experience in call center management required.
* Experience in high-volume contact center environment
* Experience with CRM technology
* Knowledge of customer experience key performance indicators and metrics for success
* Legal Authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job opening.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $59,000 - $74,000 a year.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Zūm:**

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (*Zūm CMX*™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – *Zūm CMX* is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 7,500 schools rely on *Zūm CMX*. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

### **Who You Are:**

Zūm provides safe, reliable, technology-enabled student transportation for school districts. As we launch new districts and deepen existing partnerships, we’re hiring a Customer Experience Manager to own the district relationship once the contract is signed.

You’ll be the day-to-day partner for transportation directors and district leaders in your region. That means working side by side with Operations to deliver on our commitments, staying on every issue until the district confirms it’s resolved, and presenting results to district leadership and boards. You’ll also spot risk early and lead renewal conversations. This is a hands-on role for someone who is organized, responsive, and just as comfortable in the district office as in the yard.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **District partnership:** Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for assigned districts, building trusted relationships with transportation directors and district staff.
* **Presentations and reporting:** Build and deliver business reviews, launch decks, and board or leadership presentations that clearly communicate performance, progress, and next steps.
* **Execution with Operations:** Partner daily with regional Operations and yard leaders to turn district requests and commitments into action and confirm they are completed.
* **Direct follow-up:** Own communication back to districts on open issues, service concerns, and requests, with clear timelines, status updates, and closure.
* **Escalations:** Identify service gaps early, document them, and route them to Operations, Technology, or Finance. Keep the VP informed on high-risk accounts.
* **Retention:** Monitor account health and sentiment, flag churn risk early, and carry out account plans set with the VP.
* **Renewals and growth:** Prepare renewal materials and support Ops and Sales on rebids, renewals, and expansion opportunities.
* **Onboarding:** Coordinate launch activities for new districts, including readiness checklists, dry runs, and district and family communications.
* **Technology adoption:** Train and support district staff and families on the Zūm CMX platform and drive usage.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track health scores and KPIs, including on-time performance, response times, and sentiment, and turn them into weekly action.
* **Voice of customer:** Capture district feedback and share recurring themes with Product, Technology, and Operations.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30 days:** Learn the product, shadow handoffs, and meet your assigned districts and regional Ops leads.
* **First 90 days:** Establish strong rapport as district thought partner, run kickoffs or take over existing accounts, with a success plan in place for each district.
* **First year:** Hit retention and renewal targets, improve on-time performance and response metrics in your region, and contribute to the CS playbook.

### **What You Bring To Zūm:**

* 5+ years in customer experience/success, account management, or district-level roles in student transportation, logistics, SaaS, or a similar service-critical field.
* Strong presentation skills, with experience building and delivering executive-ready materials to district leaders or boards.
* Proven ability to coordinate with operations teams and drive cross-functional work to completion.
* Exceptional organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple districts and deadlines at once.
* Fluency with customer data, turned into weekly action.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to travel up to 80% within the region.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of equity or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more. The targeted pay range for this role in US CA is: **$115,000 to $145,000**

jobs.description:
**ABOUT SITELINE**

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

**WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING**  
  
Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

**WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?**

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

**THE ROLE**
------------

Siteline is looking for a strategic Customer Success Manager to own our mid-market customer accounts. You'll serve as a strategic advisor and account manager to construction finance, operations, and project leaders, driving measurable business outcomes across the full post-sale lifecycle—from onboarding and adoption through renewal and expansion.

We're an early-stage startup where priorities evolve, processes are still being built, and there's real opportunity to make an impact. You'll need to move quickly, navigate ambiguity, and wear multiple hats, balancing strategic account management with hands-on problem-solving and execution.

You'll partner closely with our Customer Enablement, Integrations, and Technical Support teams, who provide specialized expertise in training, integrations, and troubleshooting. While these teams support execution, you'll remain accountable for coordinating resources, navigating customer challenges, and driving customer outcomes and account growth.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
------------------

* **Strategic Account Management:** Own a portfolio of mid-market accounts, building multi-threaded relationships with executive sponsors and key stakeholders across finance, operations, and project teams. Maintain strategic account plans and a proactive customer engagement cadence.
* **Product & Industry Expertise:** Develop deep expertise in Siteline's platform, construction billing workflows, and industry best practices. Serve as a knowledgeable advisor who helps customers solve business challenges, optimize workflows, and get more value from the product.
* **Onboarding & Value Realization:** Lead customer success planning and coordinate multi-stakeholder rollouts from kickoff through first live billing. Define success milestones, coordinate with Integrations and Training, remove adoption barriers, and help customers establish repeatable workflows.
* **Adoption & Growth:** Drive adoption across teams, projects, and business units. Identify opportunities to expand platform utilization, including additional modules, integrations, and billing workflows.
* **Executive Business Reviews:** Lead strategic business reviews that connect product adoption to measurable outcomes, such as billing efficiency, time saved, and projects managed. Translate results into actionable recommendations and account growth plans.
* **Renewals & Retention:** Own renewal strategy, forecasting, and execution for your portfolio. Proactively identify risk, engage decision-makers, and develop retention plans to protect gross and net revenue retention.
* **Expansion Strategy & Execution:** Own the full expansion cycle, from value-based discovery and pipeline development through negotiation and close. Drive upsell and cross-sell revenue by identifying opportunities to extend Siteline's impact across customer teams, projects, and workflows. Partner with Sales on pricing strategy.
* **Customer Readiness & Advocacy:** Proactively manage account health/readiness, address risks, and coordinate cross-functional teams to improve customer outcomes. Build customer advocates by consistently delivering measurable value, partnering with Marketing to develop referrals, customer references, and case studies.
* **Voice of Customer & Product Feedback:** Identify and document product friction points, unmet customer needs, and opportunities for improvement. Translate customer feedback into actionable product requests, partnering with Product to influence prioritization based on customer and business impact.

**Customer Onboarding Manager**
===============================

**Location:** Remote, United States

**Experience:** 3–5 years

**About Tessera Labs**
----------------------

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises modernize their most complex systems. Backed by Foundation Capital and built by leaders in AI (Artificial Intelligence) and enterprise transformation, Tessera delivers governed, multi-agent AI built specifically for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) modernization. Tessera compresses ERP modernization from years to weeks.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Customer Onboarding Manager owns every new customer's path from the first handoff by our GTM (Go-To-Market) team to the day the customer is live in production. Your job is to make that path shorter, more predictable, and easier for the customer.

Today, the slowest part of a deal comes after the first sales conversation. Customers need internal approvals before a POC (Proof of Concept) can start: security questionnaires, compliance reviews, infrastructure and architecture questions, and procurement steps. Most of the delay sits on the customer's side, and some sits on ours. You will close both gaps.

You join the customer from the first call, build a shared onboarding plan, and track every open item until it is done. You chase approvals on the customer's side and pull in the right people on ours: GTM, TPM (Technical Project Management), Security, Compliance, and Infrastructure. You do not answer deep technical questions yourself; you make sure the right expert answers them on time.

You will also find the patterns behind the delays and fix them, turning one-off efforts into a repeatable onboarding process.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**End-to-End Onboarding Ownership**

* Take the handoff from GTM and join customer calls from the start of each engagement.
* Build a shared onboarding plan with each customer covering security review, compliance review, infrastructure questions, procurement, POC, and production go-live.
* Own the timeline, open items, and next steps for several customer onboardings at the same time.
* Keep the customer and internal teams aligned on what is done, what is blocked, and who owns each next step.

**Customer-Side Approvals**

* Map each customer's internal approval path early: who signs off on security, compliance, architecture, legal, and procurement.
* Follow up consistently with customer stakeholders to keep approvals moving.
* Help customers get what their reviewers need, such as completed questionnaires, compliance evidence, and architecture documents.
* Spot stalled approvals early and escalate through the right customer and Tessera contacts.

**Internal Coordination**

* Route customer questions to the right Tessera team (TPM, Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, or GTM) and track them to a committed answer date.
* Make sure handoffs between teams happen without dropped items or repeated questions to the customer.
* Identify internal gaps that slow onboarding, such as missing documents, slow answers, or unclear ownership, and drive fixes with the owning team.

**Process and Reporting**

* Build and maintain a repeatable onboarding playbook, including stage definitions, checklists, templates, and handoff criteria.
* Track onboarding metrics, such as time from GTM handoff to POC start and from POC to production, and report trends to leadership.
* Keep a reusable library of common customer requests and answers with the owning teams so later onboardings move faster.
* Use AI tools to speed up tracking, follow-ups, and reporting.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation management, customer success, project coordination, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B (business-to-business) software company.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to lead calls with customer stakeholders and follow up without being prompted.
* A record of running several customer engagements at once and keeping each one on schedule.
* Experience building processes from scratch, such as playbooks, checklists, and trackers, and getting other teams to use them.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with a habit of clear written status updates.
* Basic understanding of what enterprise security reviews, compliance requirements, and cloud deployments involve. You need to understand the questions well enough to route them; you do not need to answer them.
* Comfort working across teams where you have influence but not direct authority.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience onboarding enterprise customers through security reviews, vendor due diligence, or procurement at an enterprise SaaS (Software as a Service) or AI company.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) or ISO/IEC 27001 (International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission 27001).
* Exposure to regulated or government customers with long approval cycles.
* Experience with project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or a CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system.
* Background at a high-growth startup.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is a fully integrated media, analytics, technology, and customer engagement organization that helps healthcare brands create meaningful, measurable connections with healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and consumers. Our teams bring together media, omnichannel strategy, analytics, CRM, creative, influencer, technology, medical communications, integrated communications, and engagement expertise to design connected customer experiences that drive business outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

As a Supervisor, you'll serve as a key client contact, a confident strategic contributor, and a hands-on team leader—owning tactical recommendations, leading the RFP process, and supervising a pod of Associates through Senior Managers to deliver integrated, high-quality work. In this role, you'll bring together deep digital and omnichannel expertise, proactive client communication, and a natural mentorship style to elevate both the work and the people around you.

  

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or Lambertville—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Play a lead role partnering with strategy on overall plan development; own tactical recommendations across assigned accounts spanning omnichannel, CRM, MarTech, creative, and digital workstreams.

* Lead the RFP process, evaluate vendor proposals, and contribute to negotiations with publisher and technology partners.

* Coordinate with delivery and technology partners on measurement and tracking implementation; continually improve operational processes across the pod.

* Act as the key day-to-day client contact; facilitate and lead client status meetings, present omnichannel and integrated recommendations, and deliver campaign analytics directly to clients.

* Supervise workflow and deadlines across Associate through Senior Manager-level colleagues; lead internal team syncs to communicate and manage priorities across the pod.

* Manage the team to deliver quality assurance, campaign analysis, and performance against plan — including QA of all ad placements and the financial accuracy behind them.

* Monitor financial performance for assigned brands; partner with Biz Ops on campaign authorizations and vendor reconciliation to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery.

* Lead internal training of junior team members, provide timely feedback, and contribute to performance evaluation processes.

* Mentor the planning bench, assist in hiring new team members, and model a collaborative, adaptable leadership style.

* Proactively identify, resolve, or escalate issues; deliver POVs that demonstrate industry knowledge and strategic thinking.

  

**This position is a perfect fit for you if:**

* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We're always evolving.

* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

* You are a highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

  

**What you should have:**

* 6–8 years of experience in digital marketing, client services, omnichannel strategy, or a related agency environment.

* Demonstrated expertise across omnichannel, CRM, MarTech, and customer experience, with the ability to lead tactical planning and present recommendations confidently to clients.

### **About Us**

Hawthorne Health is a leading community site network and home research visit solution provider, with 20+ sites and more than 2,000 research experienced healthcare professionals across the U.S. Hawthorne leverages convenient, trusted, healthcare locations, identified patient data, and intelligent technology to accelerate patient access, improve retention, and reduce study costs. By embedding high-quality research within local communities, Hawthorne makes clinical trials more accessible and convenient for patients. Our community-based model shortens timelines and helps bring better treatments to market, faster.

### **About the Role**

Hawthorne Health is expanding access to clinical research through community-based partnerships. The Clinical Site Partnerships & Enablement Manager will identify, evaluate, secure, and support community site partnerships that align with Hawthorne Health’s model and mission.

This person will guide prospective partners through the partnership journey—from initial outreach and fit assessment through lease negotiations, onboarding, launch, and ongoing relationship management. They will own lease negotiations for partner sites, collaborating with the Chief Financial Officer, internal stakeholders, and Legal Counsel when needed. They will also serve as the primary Hawthorne Health contact for site owners and staff, coordinating with internal teams to help each partner launch successfully, operate in accordance with applicable requirements, and have a positive experience.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Build and secure site partnerships**

* Identify and develop relationships with prospective community sites that could participate in Hawthorne Health’s Site Network.
* Evaluate each site’s fit with Hawthorne Health’s model, mission, operational needs, and potential study opportunities.
* Present Hawthorne Health’s partnership model, value proposition, expectations, and support offering to prospective partners.
* Coordinate with Feasibility and other stakeholders to assess site capabilities, patient populations, staffing, space, workflow, and readiness.
* Manage partnership discussions from initial interest through internal review, approvals, and agreement completion, partnering with Finance and other appropriate teams.
* Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective partners and provide updates on opportunities, risks, and next steps.

  

**Coordinate site onboarding and launch**

* Serve as the central coordinator for a new partner’s onboarding and launch experience.
* Develop and manage onboarding plans, timelines, milestones, and communication with the partner and internal teams.
* Coordinate with Practice Operations, Logistics, Talent Acquisition, Clinical Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Feasibility, and Finance to ensure site needs and launch requirements are addressed.
* Help confirm that operational processes, resources, training, and required documentation are in place before launch.
* Surface barriers early, coordinate resolution, and keep internal stakeholders and site partners informed.
* Support consistent onboarding processes and recommend improvements as the Site Network grows.

  

**Manage ongoing partner relationships**

* **Monday.com skills:** You build boards, automations, dashboards and integrations, not just use them.
* **Excellent with Claude and Gemini:** You use both every day to draft, summarize and organize, you write strong prompts, you set up Claude Projects, and you check AI output for accuracy before it goes to anyone.
* **Google Workspace pro:** Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Meet are second nature.

Big Pluses

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top US companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. jobs.description:

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Varian Medical Systems, a Siemens Healthineers company is hiring a Clinical Training Specialist (CSL) for the Boston, MA and Albany, NY area supporting Varian Interventional Solutions (VIS) by providing in‑person case coverage, clinical education, and first-line technical support for VIS products. This role trains and guides physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on proper product use, assists during procedures in a hands‑off clinical support capacity, and ensures equipment, disposables, and procedural documentation are fully managed. The specialist also supports product installations, addresses customer training needs, contributes to medical affairs activities, and represents VIS at trainings, demos, and industry events. * May coordinate or lead customer and/or employee training classes.

***Provide first line product technical support***

* Provide first line technical service support via Engineering or Field Service Engineer oversight, when necessary.

***Collaborate with the VIS Medical Affairs Team***

* Assist Medical Education, Medical Information, and Medical Science Liaisons if required.
* Document day to day interactions with physician customers.
* Provide competitive product performance information to headquarters marketing or engineering groups.

**What You will have:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in related field preferred.
* Clinical Background – IR/CT Technician, Operating Room Nurse or Surgical Technician preferred.
* Experience/Knowledge of IR suite, Operating Room Protocol and Sterile Technique.
* Experience in supporting vascular procedures highly regarded.

* Ability to work in a high-intensity, fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail oriented with excellent organizational skills.
* Analytical with an ability/desire to solve problems.

***We're looking for an experienced Account Manager with a strong background in payments to join our growing team at Thredd.***

*You'll work with key clients across the US helping them succeed while playing a pivotal role in growing our business and shaping the future of payments.*

***If you're passionate about building strong client relationships, driving commercial growth and uncovering new opportunities in the evolving payments landscape, this is your chance to make a real impact.***  
  
**What you'll do as an Account Manager**

* Own and grow a portfolio of clients across the US, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders and senior decision makers
* Develop account plans to understand client objectives, identify growth opportunities and strengthen long-term partnerships
* Drive commercial growth through cross-selling, upselling and identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships.
* Lead regular client business reviews, analysing performance metrics and analysing trends to identify opportunities and deliver value.
* Manage contract renewals, pricing discussions and commercial negotiations to maximise revenue and client retention.
* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Operations and Implementations teams to deliver effective solutions and resolve complex client challenges.
* Represent the voice of the client internally, advocating for their needs and influencing product development and roadmap priorities.
* Use payments industry knowledge and market insights to anticipate client needs, identify risks and recommend opportunities for growth.
* Monitor transaction volumes, account performance and market trends to identify risks, growth opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Proactively manage client expectations, resolve sensitive issues and ensure a consistently high standard of client service.
* Develop a deep understanding of clients' business models and the payments landscape to anticipate needs, identify growth opportunities, deliver exceptional client experiences and build long-term, commercially successful partnerships.

**What you'll bring as an experienced Account Manager**

* Proven experience in account management within payments or fintech, with a strong understanding of payment processing; issuer processing experience is highly desirable.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* A track record of building and maintaining client relationships.
* Strong experience driving revenue growth, identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities and managing contract negotiations.
* A client first mindset, with the ability to manage complex or sensitive relationships and drive long-term satisfaction and retention.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Confidence managing challenging conversations, resolving conflicts diplomatically and influencing stakeholders to achieve positive outcomes.
* A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* A commercially driven and adaptable mindset, combining strategic thinking, attention to detail and professionalism under pressure.

**Where you'll work**  
Our working model varies depending on the specific role and team requirements. We strive to provide flexibility whilst ensuring that each position is best supported for optimal collaboration and performance.  
  
**About us**  
Thredd is the trusted next-gen payments partner for innovators looking to modernise their payments offering. Certified by Mastercard, Visa and Diners & Discover, we process billions of debit, prepaid, and credit transactions annually, supporting consumer and corporate fintechs, digital banks, and embedded finance providers across the globe. Our unique offering is our client-centric approach, combining hands-on support with modern, reliable, and scalable technology.  
Our assured solution accelerates the development and delivery of consumer and corporate payments components embedded within digital banks, as well as for expense management, B2B payments, crypto, lending, credit, Buy Now Pay Later, FX, remittance, and open banking innovators.  
Since 2007, Thredd has enabled market leaders through our highly reliable, secure, and scalable platform and supported many of our client's growth journeys - from early-stage startup through to globally recognized unicorns, including Monzo, Revolut, and Starling.

**Diversity and Inclusion at Thredd**  
Here at Thredd, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we would be happy to support you.  
  
**Our Values**  
Our values-driven culture is what unites our teams globally and our teams is what drives our success;  
Here are what the values mean for you in this Account Manager position;

* Own it and deliver – Taking responsibility for your own performance and being successful in your own role
* Collaborate purposefully – Building trusted relationships with colleagues, supporting activities and being successful together
* Think differently – Asking questions to check understanding and sharing your ideas to support continuous improvement
* Act courageously – Stepping out of your comfort zone and embracing change to help you learn and grow

new_jobs.title: Manager, New Verticals - Pharmacy Strategy & Operations
new_jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The New Verticals team is building the future of local commerce through expanding our product offerings on our marketplace platform. We launched in 2020 and have since then built world-class operations to delight our customers with access to Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Pharmacy and Retail delivery through our marketplace. We focus on building new businesses and scale them - this team is focused on building our Pharmacy business from the ground up.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Manager on the Pharmacy Strategy & Operations team, you will own the growth and merchant engine for DoorDash's Pharma business. You will build and execute the go-to-market plan that brings pharmacy merchants onto DoorDash, grows their volume, and keeps them. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and New Verticals platform teams to be successful.

You'll be responsible for turning the pharmacy opportunity into a repeatable motion: planning and launching GTM programs, pitching and negotiating with merchants, and shaping how we speak to returning customers about pharmacy on DoorDash. You are the owner for knowing how Pharma merchants are performing, where the funnel leaks, and where to place the next bet to drive growth. You turn targets into operating plans, and plans into measurable outcomes.

This role requires strong commercial instincts and comfort with data. You should move fluently between merchant-level detail and business-level economics, build frameworks for tradeoffs and prioritization, and familiarity with modeling different scenarios and outcomes. Experience using SQL and data visualization tools is a plus.

You will report into the GM of Pharmacy S&O and be an individual contributor, with the opportunity to build a team in the future.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Strategize.** From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
* **Operate.** Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
* **Analyze.** Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
* **Experiment.** You'll transform strategies into operational experiments, product features and net-new tooling that create measurable outcomes.
* **Build with AI.** You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
* **Lead, collaborate and Influence.** You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* **You have 6-8+ years of experience.** You've succeeded in similar cultures that are highly analytical and cross-functional (whether in tech, e-commerce, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience). Merchant-facing or healthcare/pharmacy experience is a plus.
* **You are an owner.** You're always looking for opportunities to better your work product and own the outcome – both the good and the bad.
* **You're entrepreneurial.** You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
* **You're analytical.** You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling your own data in SQL, building models, and building the tools you need to create 10x outcomes.
* **You are AI Native.** You root cause problems with a systems first approach and can identify how to automate repeatable tasks using AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini or Copilot.
* **You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot.** You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team.
* **You're a persuasive communicator.** You can pitch and negotiate with senior merchant stakeholders and align internal partners around a plan.
* **You're unafraid of ambiguity.** Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in an ambiguous, startup environment.
* **You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.** MBA is a plus!

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
