Product Support Managers power that mission, owning the end to end service delivery experience for the product and feature teams they support. We're looking for an experienced Manager to lead a team of Senior Product Support Manager to join our Support Operations team, focused on delivering exceptional agent and user experiences across all channels of support.

You will report to the Director of Support Operations and work across teams at Roblox to make a step-change in the support experience. You will lead a team of subject matter experts focused on specific Roblox’s product strategies, enabling them to create and innovate high-quality support experiences through chatbot and agent support channels. This role is highly cross-functional, bridging the gap between operations and product.

Through data-driven insights, you will drive programs around weekly business reviews, voice of the customer to ensure we are continuously making recommendations for process improvements, product enhancements, agent tooling and automation that enable a more frictionless, consistent customer experience. You will partner with product leaders, influencing their roadmaps by providing insights gained from our global customer interactions. You will also work with Engineering to ensure that identified gaps are addressed and resolved in a timely manner. Lastly, as you create recommendations, you will operationalize these recommendations through strong program management in partnership with Operations, Product, Marketing, Finance, and others.

### **You Will**

* **Lead and develop a team of Product Support Managers.** Mentor, coach, and grow your team. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and user focus.
* **Drive outcomes through metrics.** Own top-line metrics such as Contact Rate, Average Handle Time, Time to Resolution and Recontact Rate. Use data to prioritize investments and hold your team and partners accountable.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Translate customer interaction insights into recommendations that shape the product roadmap, and partner with Engineering to get gaps resolved quickly.
* **Deliver multi-quarter programs.** Scope and run large, cross-functional initiatives in technology, training, knowledge, and workflow solutions with Operations, Product, Marketing, Finance, and others.
* **Partner with our India Operations team**. Building swimlanes of the supporting work needed to enable the success of our Product Support Managers, including Escalations, knowledge base documentation and agent feedback loops.
* **Partner with BPO and workforce teams.** Make sure agent needs are met, quality is consistent, and changes land smoothly across the agent population.
* **Ensure launch readiness.** Own Product Support launch management and go-to-market documentation so CS Operations teams are ready for every release.
* **Build the knowledge foundation.** Set standards for knowledge, macros, and process documentation for internal and external audiences.

### **You Have**

* 6+ years of experience in operations management or product support, with a focus on creator and user experiences
* 2+ years of experience managing and developing people
* Experience developing processes that improve operational efficiency at scale
* Strong data skills, with experience using metrics to lead decision-making
* Strong program management skills and experience leading projects at scale
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams, specifically Product, Engineering, international and BPO workforces
* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience

### **You Are**

* **Versatile:** Comfortable across technologies and approaches, and creative and strategic with hard problems.
* **Analytical:** Energized by large, ambiguous problems, and disciplined about measuring both problems and solutions.
* **User-oriented:** You start with the needs of the user, whether a Roblox player, creator, agent, or internal engineer.
* **Team-oriented:** You lift up your team and peers and leave the organization stronger.

The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**.

Annual Salary Range

$174,100—$207

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, technically demanding construction projects across advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, and other specialized markets.

This is an opportunity for an established construction leader who enjoys taking ownership of challenging projects, leading high-performing teams, building strong client relationships, and delivering exceptional results. Ideal candidates will bring experience managing large-scale projects or multiple smaller projects in environments such as advanced technology facilities, semiconductor manufacturing, data centers, life sciences laboratories, pharmaceutical facilities, hospitals, medical centers, and other complex institutional or technical projects.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will have direct responsibility for all aspects of one large, complex project or multiple small-to-mid-sized projects. You will lead projects through every phase of the construction lifecycle, including estimating, purchasing, engineering, accounting, construction, safety, and quality assurance.

This role requires strong technical knowledge, sound business judgment, advanced problem-solving abilities, and the ability to identify and mitigate project risks. Equally important is the ability to develop, mentor, and lead project teams while building lasting relationships with clients, design partners, and key trade partners.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead new project pursuits, including the development and management of proposals, schedules, and cost estimates. Play an active role in business development activities.
* Provide leadership and expertise in design-build, design-assist, and other alternative project delivery methods.
* Plan and execute the bidding process for new projects, ensuring thorough subcontractor coverage, accurate pricing, and effective risk assessment and mitigation.
* Develop and manage conceptual and detailed estimates throughout preconstruction and construction, including GMP estimates and internal project budgets.
* Negotiate and develop contracts that protect the company's interests, minimize unnecessary risk, and maximize fee opportunities.
* Lead subcontractor selection, buyout, and contract negotiations, including the development and execution of subcontract agreements.
* Oversee all aspects of project management across complex or multiple projects, including estimating, preconstruction, procurement, submittals, change orders, RFIs, budgeting, financial reporting, cost forecasting, billing, scheduling, quality control, and project closeout.
* Proactively identify challenges, resolve project issues, and implement solutions that keep projects on track.
* Ensure permits, inspections, testing, and procurement activities are properly coordinated to prevent schedule delays.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, owners' representatives, design teams, subcontractors, and project stakeholders. Lead owner, architect, and contractor (OAC) meetings and maintain consistent communication throughout the project.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve project efficiency through construction technology, sustainability, Lean practices, and self-perform work.
* Collaborate closely with Superintendents and field management to plan, organize, and direct site activities while resolving field challenges.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop project staff, supporting their professional growth and overall team performance.
* Uphold company values, policies, procedures, ethics, and professionalism.
* Champion project safety by reinforcing safety policies, participating in safety meetings, and ensuring safety standards and practices are consistently maintained.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant construction experience.
* 10+ years of progressive construction project management experience.
* Strong project portfolio within one or more of the following sectors: advanced technology, semiconductor, data centers, mission-critical facilities, healthcare, hospitals, OSHPD/HCAI, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, laboratories, GMP, BSL, process piping, operating rooms, surgery centers, or medical centers.
* Experience managing technically complex, MEP-intensive construction projects.
* Proficiency with construction scheduling, budgeting, estimating, and project management software.
* Ability to develop, manage, and maintain detailed project schedules.
* OSHA 10 certification required. LEED AP and/or DBIA certifications preferred.
* Experience negotiating and developing contracts that protect the company's interests.
* Experience overseeing complex construction projects from preconstruction through completion.
* Demonstrated success delivering projects on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards and client expectations.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, leadership, and team development skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with conceptual estimating, budgeting, and unit cost development.
* Experience leading subcontractor selection, buyout, and contract negotiations.
* Experience managing complex or multiple construction projects, including estimating, procurement, submittals, RFIs, change orders, financial reporting, scheduling, quality control, and closeout.
* Experience with construction technology, sustainability, Lean practices, and self-perform work.
* Demonstrated ability to lead project teams and effectively manage client, subcontractor, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience working in occupied facilities or around active operations.
* Experience coordinating architects, engineers, owners, subcontractors, and specialty vendors.
* Experience with constructability reviews and value engineering.
* LEED AP and/or DBIA certification

**JOB** **TITLE****:** Project Manager 3  
**FLSA:** Exempt position  
**LOCATION**: Fremont, CA (Onsite)  
**SALARY**: $85,000 - $130,000

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Project Manager (Level 3) serves as a technical and execution lead across multiple manufacturing projects, providing direction, expertise, and problem-solving leadership in complex or high-impact situations. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, drives alignment across cross-functional teams, and supports Program Managers by translating strategic objectives into executable plans. Level 3 Project Managers are trusted advisors on project execution and actively guide and coach junior Project Managers to strengthen overall team performance.

  

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and Operations teams.

* Lead execution of multiple projects concurrently, including complex Mass Production (MP) and/or New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives.

* Provide technical and execution leadership by defining project strategies, timelines, and risk mitigation plans.

* Identify systemic risks, resource constraints, and interdependencies across projects; recommend and implement corrective actions.

* Serve as an escalation point for project issues, leading root cause analysis and recovery planning.

* Lead critical project meetings and reviews, ensuring clear decision-making, accountability, and follow-through.

* Support customer- and headquarters-facing discussions as needed, providing execution insight and feasibility input.

* Partner closely with Program Managers to support program-level planning, prioritization, and execution strategy.

* Provide hands-on guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Level 1 and Level 2 Project Managers, including review of schedules, risk plans, and communications.

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management standards, tools, and best practices across the PM team.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Deep understanding of manufacturing project lifecycles and cross-functional dependencies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects independently with minimal oversight.
* Strong execution judgment with the ability to balance competing priorities and make timely decisions.
* Excellent leadership, influence, and stakeholder management skills without formal authority.
* Advanced problem-solving and risk management capabilities.
* Strong mentoring and coaching skills with a track record of developing junior team members.
* Clear, confident communication skills suitable for senior stakeholders and cross-functional leadership.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* 5–7 years of experience in project or program management within manufacturing, engineering, or operations environments.
* Proven experience leading multiple concurrent projects and mentoring less-experienced Project Managers.

new_jobs.title: Plumbing Service Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Therma, a Legence company
  
For over 50 years, Therma has continued to redefine the mechanical construction landscapes in California. Renowned for outstanding client service and attention to detail, we balance innovative, facility-specific solutions with a pragmatic, cost-conscious approach. Today, the firm employs more than 1,100 people in 3 regional offices, and its clients represent a diverse range of market sectors, including Biopharmaceutical, Education, Healthcare, Food & Beverage, Commercial, Industrial and Data Center facilities. Our culture is open, innovative, collaborative, and fun – all reflected in recognition of Therma as a #1 Best Place to Work on multiple occasions. We create an environment that empowers & challenges employees, giving them the greatest opportunity to succeed.
  
  
Plumbing Service Project Manager
  
**Location:** San Jose, CA
  
**Job Type:** Full-time, In-Office
  
**Remote Option:** Not Available
  
  
Therma has an immediate need for an experienced Plumbing Service Project Manager based out of our San Jose office. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys managing fast-paced service work, building strong customer relationships, and taking ownership of projects from initial scope and estimate through execution and closeout.
  
The Plumbing Service Project Manager will oversee a variety of plumbing service projects, ranging from smaller repair and maintenance work to larger, more complex projects. You'll work directly with customers to understand their needs, develop scopes of work, prepare estimates and budgets, coordinate labor and materials, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and profitably.
  
This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once. Above all, you'll serve as a trusted partner to our customers and help ensure a high level of service and customer satisfaction.
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Manage plumbing service projects from initial customer request and estimating through execution, billing, and closeout.
* Develop scopes of work, budgets, estimates, proposals, and project schedules.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and serve as a primary point of contact throughout the project.
* Identify customer needs, develop service opportunities, follow up on leads, and support ongoing account growth.
* Coordinate and lead project teams, field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and internal resources as needed.
* Prepare budget projections, maintain accurate cost forecasts, and manage projects to established revenue and profitability goals.
* Track labor hours, material costs, equipment, subcontractor costs, and overall project performance.
* Estimate, prepare, and manage change orders and communicate changes clearly to customers and project teams.
* Procure materials and equipment and coordinate delivery based on project schedules and field requirements.
* Review drawings, specifications, submittals, and other project documentation; redline or mark up drawings as needed.
* Attend customer meetings, site walks, and project meetings and maintain regular communication with the field and customer.
* Troubleshoot technical and operational issues and work collaboratively with field teams to develop practical solutions.
* Identify existing plumbing systems that may not meet current plumbing codes and develop recommendations and estimates for corrective work.
* Support plumbing service and preventative maintenance needs, including storm, sewer, grease waste, and related plumbing systems.
* Apply value-engineering principles and identify opportunities to improve project execution, cost, and customer outcomes.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, contracts, change orders, forecasts, and other required project records.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to project and field teams while reinforcing accountability, safety, quality, and Therma's project management standards and procedures.

Required Qualifications
  

* 5+ years of experience in commercial plumbing, mechanical construction, or plumbing service, with demonstrated responsibility for managing projects, customers, budgets, and/or field operations.
* Strong working knowledge of commercial plumbing systems, service, repair, installation, and preventative maintenance.
* Ability to scope and estimate plumbing service and corrective work.
* Working knowledge of applicable plumbing codes and the ability to recognize existing conditions that may require corrective action.

ABOUT FAMILY SUPPORT SERVICES

Family Support Services (FSS) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening families and supporting children, youth, and caregivers. With offices in San Francisco and Oakland, FSS provides prevention, intervention, respite, and childcare services in the communities we serve.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Bilingual Respite Care Coordinator helps families access authorized respite and child care services through referral intake, scheduling, family-provider matching, documentation, and follow-up. Using a trauma-informed, culturally responsive, family-centered approach, the Coordinator works with families, providers, and department staff to support timely service delivery, accurate records, and effective communication. The ideal candidate is comfortable with technology, thinks critically when problems arise, works toward clear goals, and collaborates well with a team.

· Support referrals, intake, enrollment, and follow-up; explain program requirements, approved services, and next steps to families

· Assess family needs and provider availability, facilitate appropriate matches, and follow up to resolve routine scheduling or service barriers; elevate unresolved or sensitive matters promptly.

· Maintain confidential case notes, client/provider files, reports, and tracking records; follow up on missing forms, timesheets, and other service documentation.

· Obtain, enter, update, and coordinate family and provider schedules; follow up on missing or changed information.

· Maintain organized scheduling and service records so pending needs and interruptions can be addressed.

· Participate in assigned outreach, resource events, and provider recruitment; share approved bilingual program information.

· Provide backup respite or child care when trained and assigned; support children’s developmental, behavioral, and safety needs.

· Follow confidentiality, health and safety, and mandated-reporting procedures; promptly report incidents or significant concerns.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

· Professional bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English, including clear verbal and written communication with families and colleagues.

· At least two years of relevant family support, respite, child care, human services, or community program experience, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

· Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through; demonstrated ability to set priorities, meet goals and deadlines, and use sound judgment to solve problems.

· Strong computer skills, including Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams), databases or case-management systems, electronic timekeeping, and online program portals; able to learn new software quickly and solve basic technical issues independently.

· Valid California driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, reliable transportation, current registration, and auto insurance.

· Ability to meet background-clearance, training, mandated-reporting, and direct-service requirements; flexibility for occasional evening and weekend assignments.

· Bachelor’s degree in human services, social services, child development, psychology, sociology, family studies, education, or related field.

· Experience working with children, foster families, caregivers, individuals with disabilities, or community-based programs.

· Experience coordinating respite or child care schedules, authorizations, and provider relationships.

Candidates with applicable experience are encouraged to apply even if they do not hold a bachelor’s degree.

Salary: $53,000–$58,000 annually, depending on qualifications and experience. new_jobs.description:
The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. TPRM covers the safeguards that govern how third parties (developers, partners, vendors and service providers) access, use and protect Meta user data. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. new_jobs.title: Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Beginnings matter. Whether someone is starting their career or joining a new company, their early experiences shape how quickly they find their footing and how far they can go. A great beginning gives people the context, skills, and confidence to do their best work.

As our **Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager,** you’ll own that moment for nearly everyone who joins Mercury, across new hire onboarding, internships, and a new apprenticeship program. You’ll think as deeply about the experience people have as the systems behind the scenes that make it all work, and you’ll be a visible face of Mercury when people need support most. You’ll build programs that feel distinctly Mercury, using AI and your creativity to rethink how they work from the ground up.

* *Mercury is a financial technology company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

### **Here are some things you’ll do on the job:**

* **Run new hire onboarding.** Own the program end to end: the learning arc, facilitator coordination, cohort communications, and feedback. Partner with People Operations on preboarding so the experience starts before day one and every new hire’s first weeks feel useful and welcoming.
* **Launch our new apprenticeship program.** Design and own program operations and the apprentice experience: cohort programming, exec exposure, check-ins at each rotation, and partnerships with host teams.
* **Strengthen our internship program.** Build on what teams already run with a shared company-wide experience for interns, including onboarding, community, regular check-ins, and a clear point of contact.
* **Support managers and mentors.** Give the people hosting new hires, interns, and apprentices clear expectations and the resources to do it well.
* **Build the systems behind the programs.** Use AI, automation, and tooling to reimagine what each program can do, keep quality high as hiring grows, and adapt as the technology evolves. Use feedback and data to see what’s working and improve it.
* **Tell the story of emerging talent.** Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, and leaders across Mercury to show how we invest in people early in their careers.

### **You should:**

* Have **3–5 years of experience** building and running programs, ideally in Learning & Development, People programs, early-career talent, or onboarding.
* Be an **excellent program manager**. You turn ideas into plans, keep many moving pieces organized, and follow through from launch to iteration.
* Be a **skilled facilitator.** You’ve led sessions or trainings and can turn what people need to know into something they learn.
* **Be hands-on with AI.** You experiment with new tools, know when they help, and use them to rethink what our programs can do.
* **Think in systems.** You spot themes across pain points, trace them back to how the program is designed, and solve them systematically.
* Be **creative and comfortable with ambiguity**. Some programs are established, some are new, and you’re energized by figuring out what fits Mercury.
* Be a **clear, warm communicator**. You can welcome someone on day one, run a room, and write a crisp message. You own the details, ask good questions, and stay open to changing your mind.

Experience with **early-career, university, internship, apprenticeship, or employee onboarding programs** is a strong plus.

### **Location and on-site expectations**

This role is hybrid and based in **San Francisco**, home of our apprenticeship program. You’ll spend time in the office with our apprentices and join workshops, programming, and other in-person moments. You’ll also support interns in San Francisco and New York, some in person and some remotely.

new_jobs.title: Scaled Account Manager, Beneficial Deployments
new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Nonprofits, universities and other mission-driven organizations do some of the hardest work in the world, usually with small teams and little technical capacity. As a Scaled Account Manager in Beneficial Deployments, you will be the person a named book of these organizations can rely on. You will own each customer relationship after the first conversation, including commercials, activation and the conversations that turn a new deployment into everyday use.

This role sits on the Scaled Sales team within Beneficial Deployments, the part of Anthropic that brings Claude to mission-driven organizations sooner and further than the market would on its own. You will work with little to no dedicated Customer Success support, so you are both the seller and the person who helps a customer get real value.

That is only possible if you work differently. You will use Claude to take on the short-horizon tasks that consume a book like this, and spend your time on strategic conversations. The role will also change. As we automate more of this work, the book will take less of your time, and that time moves to growth: deeper work with your highest-potential accounts, launches, events and programs that reach many more organizations. We are hiring someone who wants that: someone who will automate parts of their own job and move on to the next hard problem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own a named book of nonprofit and education customers.** Take over existing relationships and run them end to end: retention, seat growth, plan moves and new contacts inside each organization.
* **Drive activation yourself.** Help priority customers in the segment go from purchased seats to weekly use, starting with where staff lose the most time: fundraising, grant writing, reporting and program operations at nonprofits, or research support, teaching and administration in higher ed.
* **Automate your own work.** Use Claude to handle account research, follow-ups, usage reviews and routine questions, then share what works so the whole team can use it.
* **Spend your time on strategic conversations.** Work with executive directors, operations leads, and IT and academic leaders at universities to find the use cases that matter to their mission and agree what success looks like.
* **Spot who is ready for more.** Identify customers moving from individual productivity toward redesigned workflows, build the case, and bring in Applied AI or other specialists when they qualify for deeper support.
* **Build programs, not one-offs.** When ten customers have the same problem, create a playbook, webinar or cohort that solves it once.
* **Be the voice of your book.** Bring what you hear to Product, Marketing, Support and Operations, and work across those teams to get customer problems fixed.

**Where your time goes as we automate**
---------------------------------------

The role starts mostly account-facing. Over roughly the first six months, we expect Claude to take on much of the routine work, and your time shifts toward growth. Examples of where it goes:

* **Deeper with priority accounts.** Spend real time with the 10 to 15% of your book that can move from individual productivity to redesigned workflows, and get them there.
* **Quarterly launches.** Beneficial Deployments brings new offerings to the nonprofit and education community each quarter. Help drive them: coordinate across Marketing, Comms and partner teams, and make sure your customers benefit.
* **Events.** Help shape and run the events, local and eventually international, that become a core part of how we reach new organizations.
* **New signups and scaled partnerships.** Contribute to the motions that bring new organizations onto Claude, including partner channels and programs for segments we don't yet serve well.

The exact mix will change, and you will help decide it. Part of the job is working out which tasks should be automated and which still deserve a person's time.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
-------------------------------------

* 3+ years of account management or customer success experience with nonprofit or higher education customers, with a proven track record of growing retention and driving adoption of new technology
* Have owned customer relationships in an account management or customer success role, and can point to accounts you grew, retained or turned around
* Use AI in your own work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back
* Bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and can move from a messy situation to a clear plan quickly
* Have run multi-step programs or projects with several stakeholders and kept them on track
* Have got things done through people you did not manage, across teams in a larger organization
* Stay effective when your job changes, and would see automating part of your role as a win
* Can explain AI plainly to people who are skeptical, busy or new to it
* Care about the mission of nonprofits and educational institutions, and about AI being developed and deployed safely

**Strong candidates may also**
------------------------------

* Have built something from zero, such as a company, a product, a sales motion or a new program, or been an early employee at a startup
* Have a consulting background, with experience across many sectors and problem types
* Have worked at an AI-native company or sold AI products, or moved from business development into owning accounts
* Have worked in or with nonprofits, foundations, Universities or other mission-driven organizations
* Understand how nonprofits

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

new_jobs.title: Security & EHS Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Our collective future depends on carbon-free transportation. To forge that future, Voltera develops, owns, and operates the infrastructure that enables companies to succeed at scale with zero-emission vehicles. We're looking for innovative, people-first team members who understand that culture is critical in our effort to positively impact the world's transition to a carbon-free transportation future.

Voltera is seeking a Security & EHS Operations Manager to lead day-to-day security and environmental, health, and safety (EHS) operations across all of Voltera's workplace and commercial locations nationwide. This is a hands-on, full-time role, not a purely strategic one: you will directly supervise the Security Desk and embedded security staff, own the technology that runs physical security day to day, and build out the data and reporting function that gives leadership visibility into both programs.

You should be comfortable working hands-on with security-specific technology and systems on a daily basis, and equally comfortable managing the outsourced EHS expertise that supports workplace safety and the environmental requirements that come with operating EV charging sites. You don't need to be the technical EHS expert yourself; you need to understand the requirements well enough to manage that vendor relationship and make sure its guidance translates into real execution on the ground. This role also partners closely with the teams supporting a site's full development lifecycle — Real Estate, Development, and Construction — with People Operations and Workplace teams supporting Voltera's distributed worker base, and with customer security and safety teams at partner locations.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

**Security Operations**

* Directly supervise 24/7 Security Desk operations, including scheduling, performance, and day-to-day direction of embedded security staff.
* Own and operate Voltera's core security technology stack nationwide — access control & badging systems, video management systems (VMS), and visitor management systems — including user provisioning, credentialing, and system health.
* Coordinate incident response, investigations, and post-incident reporting across all locations.
* Manage third-party physical security consulting engagements, including scope, deliverables, and program design and execution.
* Evaluate and expand security coverage models — embedded staffing, technology, and patrol — as new and newly acquired sites come online.
* Own security-related vendor budgets, invoicing, and SOW/PO administration.

**Data & Reporting (Security + EHS)**

* Own the data and reporting function for both security and EHS programs, building and maintaining the metrics, dashboards, and reporting cadence leadership uses to track both — pulling in vendor-supplied data as a key input.
* Serve as the source of truth for security and EHS KPIs — incidents, access activity, audit findings, and vendor performance — across the nationwide portfolio.
* Standardize status reporting and escalation flags so open issues in either function surface quickly.

**Work Order & Vendor Coordination (Security + EHS)**

* Issue and manage work orders for security device service calls — access control, cameras, visitor management hardware, and alarm systems — through Voltera's CMMS.
* Issue and manage work orders for safety and environmental equipment inspections and servicing — fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, eyewash stations, AEDs, spill kits, and similar life-safety and environmental equipment.
* Coordinate with the Facilities team on incidents that require facility repairs — damaged doors, gates, locks, or other physical damage resulting from a security or EHS event.
* Manage vendor relationships and SLAs for security and EHS equipment maintenance, inspection, and repair, tracking completion alongside other security and EHS KPIs.

**EHS Operations**

* Own and manage the vendor relationship and platform — Voltera's primary source of EHS technical expertise — and lead its expansion to commercial sites nationwide.
* Serve as the operational point of contact for EHS-specific vendors and software tools, translating their technical guidance into day-to-day execution across the portfolio.
* Partner with EHS vendors to maintain compliance with OSHA and applicable state/local workplace safety regulations across all workplace and commercial locations.
* Leverage vendor expertise to manage environmental compliance requirements across the portfolio — hazardous materials handling, spill prevention and control (SPCC) plans, stormwater management, and environmental permitting related to charging equipment, battery storage, and backup power systems — ensuring vendor recommendations are implemented on the ground.
* Coordinate with EHS vendors to develop and maintain emergency response, site evacuation, and spill/hazmat response plans, and lead staff training and drills.
* Lead safety and environmental incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action tracking, pulling in vendor expertise where technical review is needed.
* Coordinate recurring safety and environmental compliance audits and risk assessments nationwide, partnering with EHS vendors on technical assessment and ensuring findings are tracked to closure.

**Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with the Real Estate, Development, and Construction teams across a site's full development lifecycle — from pre-development through construction and into operations — to plan security and EHS requirements at each phase.
* Design and manage an integrated guarding strategy that makes the best use of vendor resources across project phases, from construction-site security through steady-state operational coverage.
* Partner with customer security teams at partner and host locations to improve information sharing and operational efficiencies.
* Partner with People Operations and Workplace teams to ensure safe and secure working environments

**Customer Program Manager**

**Modus Advanced, LLC**

**Location:** Remote

**Pay Range:** $75,000–$140,000, depending on experience

Full-Time, Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW

Modus Advanced is looking for a Customer Program Manager to own the full order execution lifecycle for our most strategic accounts in aerospace, defense, and commercial space. This is not a sales role. There is no quota, no pipeline to manage, and no prospecting. What there is: ownership, complexity, and high stakes.

You will drive orders from PO receipt to shipment for programs where schedule failures have real consequences — defense systems on critical paths, commercial space launch windows, and medical devices that cannot be late. You will coordinate across Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Pre-Production to keep programs moving, surface constraints before they become problems, and communicate with precision to customers who have zero tolerance for ambiguity.

The right person for this role has a project management or program management background in a manufacturing or technical environment. You are used to owning outcomes, not just tracking them. You know how to read a production schedule, understand lead time dynamics, and translate operational reality into clear, confidence-building communication for demanding customers.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Orders for key accounts ship on time or early, consistently
* Constraints and risks are surfaced early — with a proposed resolution, not just a problem statement
* Internal teams view you as a reliable, proactive partner who removes roadblocks
* Customers feel fully informed at every stage of the order lifecycle
* Business Central and customer portals reflect accurate, real-time order status at all times

* Able to deliver difficult updates clearly and professionally without losing customer confidence
* Strong listening instincts — you understand what a customer actually needs, not just what they asked for

* Strong ownership mindset — you treat your accounts as if they were your own program
* Proactive by default: you identify issues before they become problems and bring solutions
* Highly organized and detail-oriented — you track the details others miss
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift
* Collaborative team player who builds credibility through reliability and follow-through

**ABOUT SITELINE**

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

**WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING**  
  
Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

**WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?**

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

new_jobs.title: Compliance Operations Associate (CCO Development Track)
new_jobs.description:
**The Role**

You will be the operations engine behind our COO and CCOs. You will run our project management in Monday.com, own the regulatory calendar for every client, and give our CCOs the support they need to get filings and reviews done right and on time.

**Your path is to become a CCO, and we will train you.** This is not a dead-end admin job. You will learn broker-dealer, investment adviser and fund compliance from people who have sat in the CEO, CCO, COO and FINOP seats. As you grow, you will take on more of the compliance work yourself, add registrations, and build toward a CCO seat of your own.

**Who You Are**

You might be an administrator or project manager in financial services today, or a compliance professional who has not held a CCO seat yet. Either way, you want a career in compliance and you are ready to learn.

* **Organized:** You love systems, never let a deadline slip, and follow up without being asked.
* **Hungry:** You want to become a CCO, and you are willing to put in the work to get there.
* **Curious:** Our clients span ETFs, crypto, annuities, private placements and more. You want to understand how all of it works.
* **Coachable:** You are open to new ways of working, including our processes, templates and AI-driven workflows.
* **Team-first:** You share what you know, ask for help when you need it, and celebrate the wins together.

**What You Will Do**

Project Management & Regulatory Calendar

* Run the regulatory calendar for every client, covering deadlines such as FOCUS reports, annual audits, Form ADV amendments, Form CRS updates, Forms N-PORT and ATS-R, FINRA Rule 4530 statistics, FINRA Rule 3130 certifications and state renewals.
* Take in new compliance projects (membership applications, exam requests, annual reviews, AML tests, marketing reviews), break them into tasks and assign each one to the right person.
* Set internal due dates well ahead of regulatory deadlines, follow up with owners, and flag anything at risk to the COO and the responsible CCO.
* Run weekly status reviews so leadership can see open items, upcoming deadlines and team capacity at a glance.

Monday.com Build-Out

* Own APCC's Monday.com workspace: board templates by firm type, automations, dependencies, deadline alerts and integrations.
* Assist with building dashboards for workload, upcoming filings, overdue items and client status.
* Keep Monday.com, our CRM and Google Drive in sync, and train the team on new workflows.

Support for Our CCOs and COO

* Help prepare filings: gather information from clients, draft forms and checklists, and organize packets for CCO review. The responsible CCO or principal reviews, signs and submits every filing.
* Gather documents for annual reviews, AML testing, exam requests and marketing reviews, and organize them for the CCO.
* Maintain records: save submission confirmations, review sign-offs and meeting notes so every client stays exam-ready.
* Manage calendars, schedule client meetings, take AI-assisted notes and send action items within one business day.
* Keep client files in Google Drive organized, and protect confidential and nonpublic personal information under our Regulation S-P procedures.

Learning the CCO Seat

* Shadow our CCOs on filings, annual reviews, AML testing and regulatory exams.
* Take on compliance tasks as you learn, with a CCO reviewing your work.
* Work toward additional registrations, such as the Series 7 and Series 24, with our support.

**What You BringMust-Haves**

* **SIE (Securities Industry Essentials)** exam passed, or a current FINRA registration
* A career goal in financial services compliance, with your sights set on becoming a CCO. You are committed to getting your Series 24.
* **2+ years** in an administrative, project management, operations or compliance role, ideally in financial services.
* **Monday.com skills:** You build boards, automations, dashboards and integrations, not just use them.
* **Excellent with Claude and Gemini:** You use both every day to draft, summarize and organize, you write strong prompts, you set up Claude Projects, and you check AI output for accuracy before it goes to anyone.
* **Google Workspace pro:** Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Meet are second nature.
* Highly organized, discreet with confidential information, and a clear, concise writer.

Big Pluses

* Experience at a broker-dealer, RIA, fund administrator or compliance consulting firm.
* Familiarity with filings such as FOCUS, Form ADV, Form CRS and Form U4/U5.
* Additional registrations, such as the Series 7, 63, 65 or 66.
* Monday.com certification, or a PMP or CAPM project management certification.
* CRM experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot or Salesforce.

**Who We Are**

**Anchor Point Compliance Consulting (APCC)** is a team of CEOs, CCOs, COOs and FINOPs who have run the kinds of firms we now support. We serve broker-dealers, investment advisers, funds and fintech innovators as their outsourced CEO, CCO, Principal, FINOP and embedded compliance partner.

We are not an "old school" compliance shop. We find the path to yes, we use modern tools and AI every day, and we like working together. Our clients range from Bitcoin ETFs and crypto RIAs to broker-dealers running ATS and private placement platforms.

**Stay Steady. Stay Compliant.**

**Anchor Point Is Growing**

We are adding new clients, new service lines and new people. This role exists because our COO and CCOs need a strong partner to keep the work moving, and we want someone who will grow into a compliance leader here with us.

**Our Values: We Are The BELAYER**

In climbing, a belayer manages the rope so the climber can focus on the ascent. That is what we do for our clients.

* **Balance:** We find the "yes" by balancing regulatory demands with ambitious business goals.
* **Expertise:** Decades of real-world leadership behind every deliverable.

new_jobs.title: Manager - Learning and Development
new_jobs.description:
Are you the person who looks at a team of good people and sees the next version of them? Do you believe the smartest way to close a skills gap is not always a job posting, but a learning path for the people already here? Can you design a bootcamp that takes a busy employee from curious to competent while they keep doing their day job, and a learning path they actually finish? If upskilling the people who already work here, building programs that stick, and running the Vertech Learning and Development function sounds like a good Tuesday, come build the learning engine that keeps Vertech moving forward.

**Who We Are**

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top US companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. I mean, we call ourselves control freaks for a reason. The passion (and intelligence) our employees have is truly mind-blowing. In turn, we work hard to take care of our own with excellent benefits and pay, personal development, and transparent communication. We also know that you can be great at what you do and still have fun. If that sounds like a good fit, help us bring the next generation of automation solutions to nearly every industry, including manufacturing, food and beverage, renewable energy, data centers, water and wastewater and more.

**Top Reasons to Work with Us**

* Flexible work schedule with work from home options for numerous roles
* Weekly communication from management in our internally famous Friday morning meeting
* Competitive Compensation including a bonus plan and benefits
* A manager that is cool…most of the time, because no one is perfect
* A path for growth, a great culture, PTO, AND MORE!

What You Will Be Doing

* Build role-based learning paths that take someone from their first week to their next role, covering onboarding, up-skilling, reskilling, career growth, and succession planning.
* Own VertechLEADS end to end: curriculum, scheduling, communications, facilitator coordination, participant experience, and the continuous improvement that keeps it worth showing up for.
* Design, develop, coordinate, and deliver manager and leadership programs that people look forward to instead of quietly dread.
* Find the real capability gaps by pairing business planning with performance data, manager input, employee feedback, and capability assessments, because guessing is not a strategy.
* Create the curriculum, facilitator guides, participant materials, assessments, job aids, and everything else that makes a session run well when the room is full.
* Manage learning calendars, vendors, budgets, learning technology, and program records, because the work behind the scenes is what makes the front of the room look easy.
* Use participation, completion, learner feedback, and business outcomes to keep improving the programs, and make sure everything reflects Vertech policies, safety expectations, compliance requirements, and the culture we are building.

What You Need for this Position

* Four-year degree in Learning and Development, Human Resources, Education, Organizational Development, Business, or a related field, or equivalent education, skills, and experience.
* Five years of progressive experience in learning and development, instructional design, organizational development, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing curriculum and delivering manager or leadership training.
* Experience building role-based learning paths and blended learning programs.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for manager, leadership, and employee audiences, a collaborative coaching style, and the project management to keep several programs moving at once.
